title: Project Technician
description:
Project Technician

BUSINESS UNIT: BeyondReach

FUNCTION: Service

REPORTS TO: Director of Operations

CLASSIFICATION: Non-Exempt

LOCATION: Cedar Rapids, Iowa

EDUCATION: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; industry certifications (e.g., Ubiquiti, network/RF fundamentals)

EXPERIENCE: 1-3 years


Who We Are Looking For

BeyondReach, a CCR company, provides connectivity solutions and infrastructure to any location, no matter how remote or complex, specializing in the hard-to-reach locations.


Our ideal candidate thrives in a hands-on, fast-paced environment and takes pride in getting the details right the first time. This role requires a detail-oriented, dependable Project Technician who can confidently prepare and pre-configure radio and CPE hardware before it reaches a site, support circuit turn-up on install day, and keep project records accurate as work is completed.

The Project Technician is expected to work closely with the Project Coordinator, Engineers, RF Engineering, and the NOC, escalating only genuine anomalies rather than routine steps, to ensure every site is staged, tested, documented, and turned up right.


What You’ll Accomplish and Experience

Radio & CPE Provisioning (Pre-Stage)

  • Stage and pre-configure Ubiquiti and Siklu radios for implementations.
  • Assemble and test 5G indoor/outdoor setups at the warehouse.
  • Label, inventory, and kit hardware for each site (radios, POE, cabling, mounts).
  • Document IP assignments and management addressing per the provisioning sheet.
  • Assemble link pairs for staging at HQ for larger projects.

Circuit Turn-Up & Vendor Coordination (Day-of)

  • Own the turn-up day checklist independently.
  • Run and capture standard acceptance tests (speeds, pings, LAN IP routing, etc.) and document results.
  • Confirm demarc and review the install via photos while techs are still on site.
  • Capture all day-of install results and deliver them to the Project Coordinator/Engineer for review.
  • Escalate to RF Engineering only on genuine anomalies (alignment, signal level, path issues) and not routine steps.

Documentation & System Hygiene

  • Consistently update Sitetracker task/milestone status at turn-up so records reflect reality.
  • Attach test results, configs, and as-built notes to the project record.
  • Maintain the provisioning/turn-up templates and a simple runbook as procedures firm up.

Tier 1 Monitoring Assist

  • Perform first-look triage on alerts, basic reachability checks, and radio reboots under NOC direction.
  • Confirm/clear false alarms before they escalate to engineering.

Desirable Previous Experience

  • Working knowledge of Ubiquiti and Siklu radio platforms, including staging and configuration.
  • Familiarity with 5G indoor/outdoor CPE hardware and PoE-powered equipment.
  • Understanding of IP addressing and management networks well enough to assign and document per provisioning sheet.
  • Ability to run and interpret standard acceptance tests (speed tests, ping/latency, LAN IP routing).
  • Comfortable with basic RF concepts (alignment, signal level, path/line-of-sight) well enough to recognize a genuine anomaly.
  • Experience with Sitetracker or similar project/task-tracking systems, or ability to learn quickly.
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Comfortable with hand tools, cabling, and mounting hardware for kitting and warehouse assembly.
  • Ability to coordinate with field techs, vendors, and RF Engineering to complete installations.


Why BeyondReach

At CCR Technologies, the parent company of BeyondReach, you are not just joining a company, you are becoming a part of a team that has been delivering innovative technology solutions for nearly four decades. We’re a nationally recognized, award-winning organization committed to excellence, growth, and creating an environment where people love to work. As an eleven-year Great Place to Work® certified employer, we take pride in fostering a culture grounded in our values of:

  • Pursue Human Excellence
  • Partner to Win
  • Create Value, Own the Outcome
  • Lead with Curiosity and Courage

CCR offers a truly unique work-life balance with competitive benefits designed to support your personal and professional well-being. From free daily lunch for onsite team members in Cedar Rapids, to comprehensive health benefits, gym membership reimbursement, 401(k), paid time off, and ongoing development opportunities, you’ll have the support you need to thrive.

At CCR, you’ll join a high-growth, high-performance organization that values driven, adaptable individuals who want to make an impact in an innovative and agile environment. It’s a place where you can truly build your future.

title: STORE KEEPER
description:
Store Keeper Job Description

We are looking for an organized, experienced store keeper to be responsible for all stock, staff management, and planning promotional campaigns for the store. Storekeeper is a person who is responsible for goods in a store. Storekeeper is very important person for the store. He is the in charge of store department and also responsible for store control.

Storekeeper Duties & Responsibilities:

• Receive and forward all types of goods and deliveries in and out of the hotel to the correct point of storage area.

• Follow all standards for issuing and receiving stock within the store's area of operation.

• Monitor and take inventory on regular basis to compile orders based on par levels or needs.

• Maintain clear and organized records to ensure all reports and invoices are filed and stored properly.

• Monitor Periodic Automatic Replacement levels for all food items to ensure proper levels.

• Responsible to verify all goods arrived as per the agreed purchase, delivery note and agreed quantity has been received.

• Responsible for storage of both food & beverage and operational stock.

• Responsible for the day-to-day check on the storage facilities of upkeep and hygiene.

• Refuse acceptance of damaged, unacceptable, or incorrect items.

• Ensure cleanliness of all areas, keeping storage areas clean & tidy and in strict compliance with hygiene regulations.

• Ensure all store requisitions are signed by concerned Department Heads (HOD’s).

• Ensure the quantity requested and the quantity issued always matches.

• Ensure store requisition form is signed by the person collecting the goods and enter into the Inventory/Materials Management System.

• Post all invoices using the MMS - Material Management System.

• Speak with others using clear and professional language.

• Follow up on documentation of after-hours issues ensuring it is in accordance with established internal controls and procedures.

• Adhere to all Health and Safety procedures particularly relating to food and beverage items.

• Conduct inventory audits to determine inventory levels and needs.

• Assist the Accounts Payable Clerk / payable assistant in finding out any cost discrepancies.

• Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.

• Extend all requisitions on a daily basis and update the inventory management software/system.

• Work closely with Purchasing to order and receive items and equipment.

• Troubleshoot any vendor delivery issues and oversee/follow up on the return process.

• Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs.

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the management or supervisors.

Storekeeper Requirements and Skills:

• Bachelor’s degree in retail management, marketing, or related fields

• Well experience in retail management or sales

• Knowledge of retail operations, merchandising, and budgeting processes

• Proven ability to develop and implement retail promotion strategies

• Positive, friendly, and organized

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office.

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

How youʼll make an impact
The Head of Technical Innovation, is a critical role within Xero APAC, joining us at a pivotal phase in our journey. Reporting to the Regional Director and forming part of the APAC Leadership Team (ALT), you will be instrumental in ensuring the commercial success of our strategic and innovative Partner and Customer Dream Suite.

Owning the external product delivery space end to end, youʼll play a key role in deeply understanding our accounting partners and customers, using these insights to develop a clear product strategy and execution plan, aligned with our business strategy and operational priorities. Youʼll then manage external development partners and internal cross functional stakeholders to deliver products and functionality which our customers and partners will love. Leaving no stone unturned, youʼll ensure the success of every launch or release, with superior internal and customer documentation and enablement, so everyone understands the value proposition, and their role responsibilities in the plan for success.

You will have strong technical fluency, gaining a deep understanding of Xeroʼs APIs and internal product capabilities, harnessing AI and creating prototypes/POC, youʼll identify and engage external development partners to work with Xeroʼs technology stack. Your mission will be to deliver product features and functionality that solve real problems and create meaningful value for our partners and customers, across APAC.

This is a highly collaborative role where you will work in lockstep with the Regional Director, the ALT, and our appointed development partners to design, build, and deliver a commercially viable, beautiful practice and customer experience. Youʼll bring to life a roadmap that reflects both market opportunity and partner/customer need, often driven by regulatory tailwinds and government initiatives, ensuring we deliver on our 12-month performance objectives from a product perspective and remain competitive in market.

Youʼll be an authentic, individual contributor with a leadership mindset, someone who loves working with people, thrives in cross-functional environments, and is passionate about achieving results by empowering and aligning talented experts from across the business.

What youʼll do

● Identify the most impactful, innovative, and commercially viable solutions for accounting practices and small businesses, prioritising those with strong alignment to regional needs and Xeroʼs strategic direction.

● Collaborate with strategic development and ecosystem partners, to design, build, and deliver a commercially viable, beautiful experience for accounting partners and customers, across APAC.

● Maintain deep knowledge of Xeroʼs APIs and stay across their ongoing evolution, ensuring partner and customer solutions are built with technical alignment and future scalability in mind.

title: Senior Auditor – Construction Industry (Singapore)
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Auditor with 20+ years of working experience in Singapore’s construction industry to conduct a comprehensive review of our existing accounting, finance and internal control systems.

This is a senior advisory and internal audit role, suitable for an experienced professional who has strong practical knowledge of construction-company accounting, project costing, cash flow management, procurement, subcontractors, GST, payroll, inventory, revenue recognition and financial controls.

The successful candidate will not only identify weaknesses but also advise management on the best accounting and finance system, processes and controls to establish for long-term business growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Internal Audit & Financial Review

  • Conduct a comprehensive internal audit of the company's existing accounting and finance processes.

  • Review the accuracy, completeness and reliability of financial records.

  • Identify financial risks, control weaknesses, process gaps and potential areas of leakage.

  • Review accounts payable, accounts receivable, cash, bank, payroll, GST and other financial processes.

  • Review company financial reporting and management accounts.

  • Recommend practical improvements to strengthen financial control and accountability.

2. Construction Accounting & Project Costing

  • Review construction/project accounting practices.

  • Assess project costing, job profitability and cost allocation systems.

  • Review material purchases, subcontractor costs, labour costs and project expenses.

  • Establish better systems for monitoring quoted cost vs actual cost vs project profit margin.

  • Review variation orders, progress claims, retention, deposits and outstanding receivables.

  • Advise on effective project-level financial reporting.

3. Finance System & Process Development

  • Review the company's existing accounting software and financial workflow.

  • Recommend the best-fit accounting/ERP system for a growing construction company.

  • Design and improve accounting workflows from:
    Quotation → Sales Order → Purchase → Project → Installation → Progress Claim → Invoice → Payment → Profitability Analysis

  • Recommend suitable automation and digitalisation opportunities.

  • Establish proper approval authorities and segregation of duties.

  • Develop practical SOPs and internal financial controls.

4. Management Advisory

  • Provide senior management with independent financial and operational advice.

  • Advise management on improving cash flow and working-capital management.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce unnecessary costs and improve profitability.

  • Recommend stronger budgeting and forecasting systems.

  • Develop meaningful management dashboards and KPIs.

  • Advise management on financial risks before they become major problems.

5. Internal Control & Compliance

  • Review compliance with relevant Singapore accounting, GST, tax and corporate requirements.

  • Assess internal controls over purchasing, payments, expenses and collections.

  • Review authorization and approval procedures.

  • Strengthen documentation and audit trails.

  • Recommend controls to prevent errors, duplicate payments, unauthorized purchases and financial leakage.

Ideal Candidate

We are looking for a senior-level professional, not simply a conventional external auditor.

The ideal candidate should have:

  • 5+ years of accounting, auditing or finance experience.

  • Strong experience with Singapore construction companies.

  • Practical knowledge of construction/project accounting.

  • Strong understanding of project costing and profitability analysis.

  • Experience conducting internal audits and financial reviews.

  • Strong knowledge of Singapore accounting, GST and financial-control requirements.

  • Experience implementing or improving accounting/ERP systems.

  • Strong understanding of AP, AR, payroll, cash flow, procurement and financial reporting.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to identify problems and provide practical solutions, not merely prepare audit reports.

  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to advise company directors and senior management.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ACCA / CA Singapore / CPA / equivalent professional qualification.

  • Audit, accounting or finance background with a Big 4, mid-tier audit firm or established construction company.

  • Experience with accounting/ERP platforms such as Xero, QuickBooks, MYOB, SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle, Zoho or similar systems.

  • Experience in construction, engineering, aluminium & glass, renovation or building-related businesses is highly preferred.

Key Deliverables

Within the engagement, the successful candidate will be expected to help management establish:

  1. Comprehensive Internal Audit Report

  2. Finance & Accounting System Review

  3. Construction Project Costing System

  4. Project Profitability Tracking System

  5. Cash Flow & Working Capital Control System

  6. AP & AR Control System

  7. Purchasing & Payment Approval Matrix

  8. Internal Financial Control Framework

  9. Accounting/ERP System Recommendation

  10. Finance SOP & Workflow Recommendations

  11. Management Financial Dashboard & KPI Recommendations

  12. 12-Month Finance Improvement Roadmap

title: Construction Project Manager
description:
Construction Project Manager

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Chaffee County, CO


About VeroTouch


VeroTouch exists to change how homes are built.


We are a venture-backed construction technology company reimagining residential construction by combining advanced manufacturing, robotics, and traditional building expertise. At a time when housing affordability, labor shortages, and inefficiency continue to plague our industry, VeroTouch is focused on building better, faster, and smarter.


Our work sits at the intersection of construction and technology. We design and operate systems that integrate 3D printing, advanced materials, and lean production principles into real-world job sites. This is not a theoretical exercise. We are actively building homes, learning in real time, and turning those experiences into repeatable and scalable operating models.


VeroTouch is early-stage, hands-on, and execution-driven. The people who thrive here are builders in every sense of the word. They take ownership, stay calm under pressure, and care deeply about outcomes. If you are excited by challenges, energized by responsibility, and motivated by the opportunity to help define the future of an industry that rarely changes, you will feel at home here.


Position Summary

As VeroTouch grows, so does the complexity of what we are building and how we build it. The Construction Project Manager plays a central role in keeping that complexity organized, coordinated, and moving forward.


This role owns the coordination layer between design, engineering, purchasing, and on-site execution. You will manage project schedules across multiple active builds, lead material procurement and vendor relationships, and serve as the connective tissue between upstream planning and real-world delivery. You will work closely with site supervisors, subcontractors, and internal teams to ensure that work progresses on time, within budget, and in alignment with project specifications.


This is not a passive coordination role. It is designed for someone who takes initiative, builds systems, and holds themselves and others accountable to outcomes. You will help formalize and improve the processes that support a scaling construction operation, from procurement workflows and documentation standards to scheduling cadences and reporting structures.


The Construction Project Manager is a key partner in translating project goals into disciplined, consistent execution.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The essential functions include, but are not limited to, the following:


Project Coordination

  • Oversee multiple project schedules from concept through design, engineering, and construction, driving coordination across vendors, suppliers, and cross-functional teams to ensure milestones are met.
  • Partner with site supervisors and senior leadership to define material strategies, develop and execute lean just-in-time procurement schedules, and proactively identify and mitigate risks.
  • Serve as the primary communication link between design and engineering teams and on-site operations, delivering clear, actionable updates on schedule changes, resource needs, and priorities to stakeholders at all levels.
  • Identify opportunities to refine or build systems that improve project coordination, reduce manual effort, and support a more scalable operating model.
  • Delegate appropriately to support staff to maintain focus on strategic coordination, risk management, and project-level decision-making.

Material Management

  • Direct the creation and management of purchase orders, ensuring accuracy, cost-efficiency, and alignment with project specifications.
  • Lead vendor negotiations and manage supplier relationships to secure favorable delivery terms and resolve discrepancies quickly.
  • Support the design and ongoing improvement of inventory systems and material storage processes, applying best practices that enhance operational efficiency and scale.

Documentation and Reporting

  • Maintain thorough documentation of procurement activity, delivery schedules, and project performance metrics.
  • Develop and present clear status reports that surface risks, highlight opportunities, and provide actionable recommendations for leadership.
  • Lead the creation and ongoing improvement of standard operating procedures that streamline material workflows and improve team consistency.

Qualifications

Education

  • Extensive experience, a proven work ethic, and a strong commitment to continuous learning—attributes that deliver results beyond traditional education (required).

Required Experience

  • Progressive experience in construction project coordination, logistics management, or a related leadership role.
  • Strong working knowledge of residential construction processes, with familiarity across multiple phases from pre-construction through closeout.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple active projects simultaneously, coordinating across cross-functional teams and external partners.
  • Proficiency with project management tools such as Buildertrend, Procore, MS Project, or equivalent platforms, as well as ERP systems and data management tools.
  • Experience building or improving operational systems, including automated spreadsheets, tracking databases, or procurement workflows.
  • Solid foundation in project budgeting and basic accounting principles.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a demonstrated ability to align stakeholders and move work forward across teams.

Preferred Experience

  • Hands-on building or field experience in residential construction.
  • Familiarity with lean, production-oriented, or just-in-time operating models.
  • Experience in manufacturing-adjacent, prefabricated, modular, or technology-enabled construction environments.
  • Comfort operating in early-stage or startup environments where flexibility, resourcefulness, and adaptability are essential.

How You Operate Here

This role works best for someone who brings strong organizational instincts paired with a bias toward action:

  • Ownership: You take responsibility for outcomes and follow-through.
  • Bias for action: You help work move forward while staying thoughtful, grounded, and process-aware.
  • Emotional steadiness: You remain calm, clear, and solutions-oriented when timelines tighten or conditions change.
  • Respect for process: You value structure and discipline and use them to enable speed, clarity, and repeatability.
  • Accountability: You deliver with autonomy and own your outcomes.
  • Curiosity: You are interested in improving how work gets done and adapting as tools, methods, and models evolve.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

  • Ability to work on active construction sites and perform standard on-site activities
  • Ability to stand, walk, and move around job sites for extended periods
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat and cold
  • Ability to lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to approximately 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation

Compensation and Benefits

  • $105,000–$115,000 annual salary, commensurate with experience
  • 15 days of PTO (vacation and personal time)
  • Eligibility for health, dental, and vision coverage (eligible after 90 days)
  • Colorado Secure Savings IRA plan (eligible after 90 days)
  • Performance-based incentive bonus program (eligible after 90 days)
  • Employee Equity Plan eligibility, following successful employment and plan implementation
  • Company-paid holidays

VeroTouch is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and complying with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

title: SerDes Verification Engineer
description:
THE ROLE:

You will work on verifying and validating high‑speed interfaces used in advanced SoCs and chiplet designs. The role involves building UVM/SystemVerilog testbenches, running simulations, debugging timing and protocol issues, and evaluating signal integrity, jitter, BER, and eye diagrams. Close collaboration with design and hardware teams ensures compliance with protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, and DDR, delivering reliable, high‑performance silicon.

THE PERSON:

As a SerDes Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for the verification and validation of high-speed SerDes interfaces, including testing signal integrity, performance, and protocol compliance. You will work closely with hardware and design teams to ensure that SerDes designs meet the required specifications, operating parameters, and quality standards.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Verification of SerDes Designs: Develop and execute verification plans and testbenches for SerDes IPs (Intellectual Property) and subsystems to ensure they meet functional and performance requirements. Drive formal verification for the block and write formal properties and assertions to verify the design.
  • Testbench Development: Design and implement verification testbenches using industry-standard verification methodologies (e.g., UVM, SystemVerilog, VHDL).
  • Simulation and Debugging: Perform simulations, analyze results, and debug issues related to timing, protocol errors, and other design anomalies in SerDes blocks.
  • Performance Evaluation: Evaluate and validate performance characteristics of SerDes systems including jitter, bit error rates (BER), signal integrity, eye diagrams, and other key metrics.
  • Protocol Compliance Testing: Verify adherence to relevant SerDes protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, DisplayPort, or custom protocols.
  • Automated Testing: Develop automated regression tests to ensure the robustness and stability of the SerDes design over multiple versions and iterations.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the design, hardware, and software teams to troubleshoot issues, implement fixes, and verify design changes.
  • Documentation: Create detailed reports and documentation on verification results, test scenarios, and issues found during testing.
  • Continuous Improvement: Provide feedback for design and verification process improvements and contribute to innovation in verification strategies and methodologies.

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience in SerDes verification or high-speed communication verification.
  • Strong hands-on experience with verification methodologies such as UVM, SystemVerilog, or other simulation-based verification tools.
  • Knowledge of high-speed serial protocols such as UCIe, PCIe, Ethernet, USB, DDR, or custom protocols.
  • Experience in analyzing and interpreting signal integrity issues, jitter, BER, and eye diagrams.
  • Solid understanding of SerDes architectures, link training, and equalization.
  • Strong debugging skills, with the ability to work across multiple domains (timing, protocol, performance).
  • Familiarity with hardware description languages (HDL) like VHDL or Verilog.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience with DDR protocol (e.g., DDR3, DDR4, DDR5) for memory interface verification.
  • Understanding of UCIe protocol and its role in chiplet-to-chiplet communication.
  • Experience with Python, Perl, or similar scripting languages for automation.
  • Exposure to high-speed memory interface design and verification, including DDR controller IP verification.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple verification tasks.

ACADEMIC CREDENTIALS:

  • Bachelors or Masters degree in computer engineering/Electrical Engineering

LOCATION:

Singapore

description:
Role Summary

· Running automated processes for statement and advice verification.

· Handling administrative and operational support activities within the division.

Key Skills Required

Technical

Professional

· Good communication and interpersonal skills.

· Ability to work independently while collaborating with a team.

· Willingness to support weekend activities when needed.

· Strong attention to detail and control mindset.

Ideal Candidate Profile

Candidates would be particularly suitable if they have:

· Banking operations experience, especially in wholesale/corporate banking.

· Exposure to system parameter setup and maintenance.

· Knowledge of operational controls, statement generation, or transaction processing.

· A Degree in Banking, Finance, Business, or a related field.

Recruiter Comments:
maintain and update settings in the bank’s wholesale banking systems and make sure the systems continue to run properly for daily operations.

These system settings, also called parameters, may include things like transaction limits, processing rules, product settings, statement settings, business cut-off times, and customer or product configurations.

For example, if the bank needs to change a transaction limit from $1 million to $2 million, the Maker may be responsible for entering or preparing that change in the system. However, the Maker usually cannot approve the change alone. A Checker will review the change before it becomes effective. This is known as the Maker-Checker process, which helps reduce mistakes and improve control.

On a normal working day, you may receive requests from business or operations teams to update certain system settings. You will check the request, make the required changes, and submit them for approval.

You may also run automated processes to generate or verify customer statements and transaction advices. If something does not run correctly, you may perform basic troubleshooting by checking the system settings, processes, or error logs and working with the IT team if needed.

The role may also involve maintaining records, tracking requests, preparing reports, and supporting scheduled system activities, including occasional weekend work.

Overall, this is a structured, operational, and detail-focused role. It is a good starting point for fresh graduates who are interested in banking operations, banking systems, production support, or system administration, rather than sales or software development.

title: Construction Team Technician
description:
Construction Team Technician

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Onsite in Salida, CO

Status: Non-Exempt, Full-Time

Compensation: $18.00 – $22.00 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.


About VeroTouch


VeroTouch exists to change how homes are built.


We are a venture-backed construction technology company reimagining residential construction by combining advanced manufacturing, robotics, and traditional building expertise. At a time when housing affordability, labor shortages, and inefficiency continue to plague our industry, VeroTouch is focused on building better, faster, and smarter.


Our work sits at the intersection of construction and technology. We design and operate systems that integrate 3D printing, advanced materials, and lean production principles into real-world job sites. This is not a theoretical exercise. We are actively building homes, learning in real time, and turning those experiences into repeatable and scalable operating models.


VeroTouch is early-stage, hands-on, and execution-driven. The people who thrive here are builders in every sense of the word. They take ownership, stay calm under pressure, and care deeply about outcomes. If you are excited by challenges, energized by responsibility, and motivated by the opportunity to help define the future of an industry that rarely changes, you will feel at home here.


Position Summary

The Construction Team Technician is a hands-on, field-based role responsible for supporting and executing a variety of manual labor tasks across VeroTouch’s active job sites. This role is well-suited for someone with a solid work ethic and a background in construction or general labor who is eager to contribute to a fast-paced, purpose-driven team.


The Construction Team Technician works directly alongside the construction team on active job sites. The role emphasizes efficient execution, attention to detail, and a willingness to follow direction and adapt to evolving site conditions. Most training occurs on the job — a strong foundation in construction fundamentals is the starting point.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Site Labor and Maintenance

  • Execute general construction labor tasks efficiently as directed, including site preparation, cleanup, and material handling and movement.
  • Operate a variety of heavy construction equipment, execute routine maintenance procedures, and perform basic diagnostics while adhering to strict safety standards and manufacturer guidelines.
  • Strictly adhere to all safety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and site-specific standards at all times.
  • Maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment throughout all phases of the project to support operational efficiency and compliance.

Material Handling

  • Load, unload, and transport materials, tools, and equipment across job sites in support of daily production needs.
  • Handle and move raw materials and supplies to support ongoing operations.
  • Maintain accurate records of material usage and assist with inventory tracking.

Trade and Equipment Support

  • Assist skilled trades — including carpenters, operators, and concrete workers — as directed by lead technicians and supervisors.
  • Operate hand tools and power tools in a safe and effective manner.
  • Support installation, repair, and maintenance of construction components as assigned.

Team Support

  • Collaborate effectively with the construction team, operations staff, and on-site crews to consistently achieve daily production goals.
  • Receive direction from lead technicians and supervisors and respond promptly and efficiently to evolving site conditions and priorities.
  • Demonstrate a proactive learning mindset and a willingness to take on new responsibilities as skills and experience develop.

Qualifications


Education

  • A proven work ethic and commitment to continuous learning — attributes that deliver results beyond formal education.

Experience

  • Minimum of two years of relevant experience in construction, industrial labor, or a related technical field.
  • Proven hands-on experience operating construction tools and equipment in active job site environments.

Skills

  • Demonstrated ability to follow instructions with precision and execute tasks efficiently and effectively.
  • Proven strong work ethic, exceptional reliability, and a proactive team-oriented mindset.
  • Solid mechanical aptitude with demonstrated comfort and competence in working with tools, machinery, and technical equipment.
  • Strong technological proficiency and adaptability to digital tools and systems.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to receive and provide clear, concise direction.
  • Genuine interest in construction technology, innovative building methods, and emerging industry advancements.

Physical Demands and Work Environment

The physical demands and work environment described below are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these functions.

  • Ability to work on active construction sites and perform standard on-site labor tasks.
  • Ability to stand, walk, and move around job sites for extended periods.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat and cold.
  • Ability to lift, carry, or move materials weighing up to approximately 50 pounds, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Compensation and Benefits

  • 10 days of PTO (vacation and personal time).
  • Eligibility for health, dental, and vision coverage (eligible after 90 days).
  • Colorado Secure Savings IRA plan (eligible after 90 days).
  • Performance-based incentive bonus program (eligible after 90 days).
  • Company-paid holidays.

VeroTouch is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a drug-free workplace. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and complying with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. If a candidate with a disability requires accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact Felix Heeter at fheeter@verotouch.com.


This job description outlines the primary duties and requirements of the role but does not limit the employee to those duties. Certain responsibilities are considered essential functions of the position, and reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform them. This document describes the minimum requirements for the role and does not create an employment contract. Employment with the company is at-will, meaning either the employee or the company may terminate employment at any time, with or without cause or notice, subject to applicable law.

title: Customer Experience Business Systems Analyst
description:
Reporting to the Vice President, Customer Experience, the Customer Experience (CX) Business Systems Analyst is an individual contributor and the primary operational systems and analytics partner for the Customer Experience organization. The role supports Customer Service, Dispatch, Inside Sales, and Key Accounts by improving KPI reporting and analysis, administering and optimizing CX platforms, translating business needs into system and process requirements, and supporting workforce forecasts, schedule creation, and headcount planning.


The Analyst works closely with CX leaders, Corporate IT, Data and Business Intelligence, Finance, Human Resources, and external vendors. This role equips leaders with accurate data, effective tools, and practical recommendations that support service, productivity, customer experience, and conversion. CX leaders retain accountability for personnel decisions, staffing approvals, day-to-day execution, and operating results.


Location: Remote/Hybrid within WRE Operating Footprint (with Preference for commutable distance to Marlborough, MA office)


Salary Range: $75,000 - $82,000


ESSENTIAL DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:


KPI Reporting, Analytics, & Decision Support

  • Partner with leaders across Customer Service, Dispatch, Inside Sales, and Key Accounts to define and document KPI formulas, data sources, business rules, reporting dimensions, owners, targets, and reporting cadence.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve platform-native dashboards, recurring scorecards, real-time views, and ad hoc analyses. Partner with Corporate IT and Data or Business Intelligence resources on Power BI datasets, semantic models, and enterprise dashboards.
  • Provide reporting and analysis for measures such as SLA, abandon rate, CSAT, order conversion, contact volume, productivity, forecast accuracy, schedule adherence, dispatch performance, sales activity, and Key Account service commitments.
  • Reconcile data across platforms, identify inconsistencies, maintain a KPI data dictionary and report inventory, and coordinate correction of source, integration, calculation, or configuration issues.
  • Perform trend, queue, funnel, variance, root cause, and scenario analysis. Translate findings into concise operational recommendations, expected impact, owners, and follow-up measures.
  • Prepare analytics for operating reviews, workforce discussions, business cases, annual planning, and leadership requests.


CX Platform Administration & Organization

  • Serve as the primary CX functional administrator and business steward for Dialpad, PolyAI, Descartes, Salesforce, the homegrown ERP, and similar operational platforms, within approved IT and security controls.
  • Configure and maintain approved queues, routing rules, IVR paths, skills, dispositions, notifications, templates, business workflows, dashboards, and role-based access. Coordinate technical changes or integrations with Corporate IT and vendors.
  • Monitor platform usage and operational performance; provide functional support and issue triage; document incidents; and coordinate escalation, root cause analysis, resolution, and preventive action with the appropriate technical owner.
  • Manage operational configuration and performance monitoring for conversational AI voice and chat workflows, including intents, customer paths, transfers, fallback logic, and handoff to live employees. Partner with business leaders on quality review and optimization.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the homegrown ERP and other platforms. Document current-state pain points, future-state requirements, business value, priority, acceptance criteria, and dependencies for review with IT or development resources.
  • Maintain configuration records, change logs, release calendars, support procedures, user guides, and training materials. Support adoption through demonstrations, office hours, and targeted training.


Workforce Management, Scheduling, & Headcount Analysis

  • Develop and maintain short-, medium-, and long-range workload forecasts by team, channel, and interval using historical demand, seasonality, productivity or handle-time assumptions, shrinkage, operating changes, and known business events.
  • Translate forecasted workload into staffing requirements and draft schedules in partnership with the respective team leaders. Leaders approve schedules and retain accountability for attendance, deployment, and day-to-day workforce decisions.
  • Build headcount and capacity scenarios that account for hiring, attrition, leave, training, service expansion, acquisitions, budget constraints, and changes in channel mix. Partner with Finance and Human Resources as appropriate.
  • Measure actual performance against forecasts and plans, including volume, workload, coverage, schedule fit, adherence, overtime, and productivity. Explain material variances and recommend changes to assumptions, schedules, staffing, or processes.
  • Provide real-time and intraday reporting, alerts, and decision-support tools. Operational leaders are responsible for real-time staffing actions, employee communication, and adherence coaching.
  • Maintain documented forecasting methods, assumptions, versions, and decision history so workforce plans are repeatable, auditable, and understood by stakeholders.
  • Business Analysis, Process Improvement, & Project Delivery
  • Map current-state and future-state workflows; gather and prioritize business requirements; define use cases and acceptance criteria; and translate operational needs into clear requests for IT, Data, vendors, or development resources.
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing, defect tracking, release readiness, communications, training, and post-implementation review for CX system, reporting, and process changes.
  • Maintain a prioritized CX systems and analytics backlog. Evaluate requests based on customer impact, operational benefit, data quality, risk, effort, cost, dependencies, and strategic alignment.
  • Identify and recommend automation, workflow, reporting, and platform improvements that can improve the customer experience, sales conversion, productivity, dispatch execution, or employee experience.
  • Support CX merger and acquisition integration as assigned, including platform and data discovery, KPI mapping, workflow alignment, migration requirements, testing, cutover support, and post-launch stabilization.
  • Build effective working relationships across CX and with Operations, Sales, Finance, Human Resources, IT, Data, vendors, and acquired business teams. Influence decisions through clear analysis, practical options, and collaborative follow-through.


Data Quality, Access, and Operating Controls

  • Monitor data completeness, field usage, duplicate records, queue and routing setup, license utilization, report logic, and integration exceptions that affect CX operations or reporting.
  • Administer approved business access and support periodic user, role, license, and permission reviews in partnership with Corporate IT, cybersecurity, and functional leaders.
  • Follow established change-management, privacy, data-retention, security, and documentation requirements. Promptly escalate risks or control gaps to the appropriate owner.
  • Establish practical standards for report ownership, naming, version control, distribution, documentation, and retirement to reduce duplicate or conflicting information.


How Success Will Be Measured

  • KPI reporting quality - Accurate, timely, clearly defined, and reconciled reports and dashboards delivered on the agreed cadence.
  • Insight and adoption - Analyses are understood and used by CX leaders to make decisions, prioritize actions, and evaluate results.
  • Forecast and schedule quality - Reliable demand forecasts, staffing requirements, schedule recommendations, and headcount scenarios, with assumptions and variance clearly documented.
  • Platform effectiveness - Stable approved configurations, timely issue triage, controlled releases, usable documentation, and strong adoption of platform capabilities.
  • Data quality and controls - Consistent KPI logic, clean operational data, appropriate approved access, and prompt resolution of reporting or configuration defects.
  • Project delivery - Requirements, UAT, implementation, training, and post-launch follow-through are completed with clear owners, milestones, and measurable benefits.


QUALIFICATIONS


To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements below represent the knowledge, skill, and ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Three or more years of relevant experience in business systems analysis, CX or operations analytics, functional system administration, workforce management, or a related role in a contact center, service-dispatch, field-service, sales-operations, or customer-operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience administering or configuring business applications and translating operational needs into system requirements, reports, workflows, or controlled configuration changes.
  • Demonstrated experience building KPI reports or dashboards, validating and reconciling data, analyzing operational performance, and presenting findings to business leaders.
  • Experience with demand or workload forecasting, schedule creation, staffing requirements, capacity planning, or headcount scenario analysis.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Excel or equivalent analytical tools, including lookups, formulas, pivot tables, data validation, and structured models.
  • Working knowledge of relational data, reporting logic, APIs or integrations, role-based access, and data-visualization practices.
  • Experience gathering requirements, mapping processes, defining acceptance criteria, coordinating UAT, documenting changes, and supporting implementation and adoption.
  • Strong written, verbal, facilitation, prioritization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence across functions without direct authority.

Education & Preferred Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Business Administration, Operations, or a related field preferred. An equivalent combination of education, technical training, and directly relevant experience will be considered.
  • Experience with Dialpad, PolyAI, Descartes, Salesforce, and Power BI is preferred; experience with comparable CRM, CCaaS, conversational AI, route-optimization, WFM, or BI platforms is also relevant.
  • Experience supporting or improving a homegrown ERP, documenting enhancement requirements, working with developers, or coordinating system releases is preferred.
  • Experience with SQL or other reporting-query tools, data models, system integrations, workflow automation, and vendor management is preferred.
  • Experience in home services, field services, residential services, route-based operations, septic or wastewater services, or another high-volume service environment is preferred.
  • Experience supporting merger and acquisition integration, system migration, KPI harmonization, or organizational change is preferred.


The base pay range for this role is estimated to be $75,000 - $82,000 annually at the time of posting. Final compensation will be determined by various factors such as work location, education, experience, knowledge, and skills.

title: Lead Developer
description:
Job Summary

About Standard Chartered

We are a leading international bank focused on helping people and companies prosper across Asia, Africa, and the Middle East. To us, good performance is about much more than turning a profit. It's about showing how you embody our valued behaviours - do the right thing, better together and never settle - as well as our brand promise, here for good.

This is a rare opportunity to join international team of smart technologists serving global business in the financial market’s domain. The culture in the team is open, intellectual, and fun. Learning opportunities are plentiful, and career advancement is always waiting for those high-energized talents willing and able to step up.

Key Responsibilities

As a lead developer based in Singapore, you’ll lead a globally distributed team, with sharp focus on specific business domain. You will drive our platform forwards and deliver quality solutions to business-critical customer requirements. Your team will collaborate in a dynamic global organisation, with fellow engineers, business analysts, project managers and business stakeholders across multiple locations.

• Serves as senior developer, potentially leading a squad of several members.

Strategy

Business

• Take ownership of the of design and delivery of assigned features. Take ownership for and drive the delivery of platform-wide initiatives and issue remediations.

Processes

Risk Management

• According to Global and FM Technology risk management frameworks

Governance

• According to Global and FM Technology governance frameworks

Regulatory & Business Conduct

• Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.

• Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.

• Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

• Head of Development, Head of Programme Delivery, Squad Technical Leads, Scrum Masters, Project Managers, QA Leads, Business Product Owners, other Engineering Managers, Platform Architect.

Our Ideal Candidate

• 10+ years of relevant experience in full stack engineering background with deep expertise in either front end or back end development, and solid hands on experience across the other part of the stack.

• Possess good software design principles and the ability to write robust code and accompanying test suites,

• Expert or experienced in React, Redux, RX JS, NPM/Yarn, webpack, CSS, HTML and the rest of web stack.

• Expert or experienced in Java and Spring Boot. Knowledge of reactive programming is a strong plus.

• Writes efficient, clear and well tested code, and able to articulate what was built and why,

• Built complex, real-time, event-driven, highly componentized applications,

• Optimized performance of latency sensitive systems.

• Financial Market domain knowledge, preferably investment banking, Derivatives product knowledge and e-trading technology experience.

• Proven technical leadership experience with experience leading a team in an agile product development environment,

• Experienced in driving requirements and development efforts,

• Proactive and autonomous self-starter.

• Experienced in the end-to-end design, development and support complex systems,

• Keen problem solver, with strong sense of ownership and ability to deal with ambiguity.

Role Specific Technical Competencies

• Java, Spring Boot & RX Java

• Microservices, Containers and Cloud

• Architecture and System Design

• SDLC incl. Agile & Waterfall

• Financial markets domain knowledge. Knowledge in FX options will be strong advantage.

• Modular Web UI Applications (SPA)

• Apache Kafka and Cassandra experience

• Full stack integration protocols incl. REST & WebSocket

• Web UI technologies incl. JS, React, Redux, Webpack

• DevOps technologies incl. CI/CD pipelines, Promotheus, Grafana, ELK

• Familiar with Docker and Kubernetes

• People Management

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together we:

• Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

• Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

• Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.

• Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.

• Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.

• Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits

• A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.

• Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

title: Credentialing Specialist
description:
Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine is a physician-led specialty health care organization whose core business is to provide evidence-based, individualized treatment services for those suffering with chronic pelvic pain. Approximately 15-25% of men and women suffer from pelvic discomfort. In the US chronic pelvic pain impacts 28 million women and is projected to grow to 43.6 million by 2050 according to the NICHD.

Persistent pelvic pain is often overlooked, untreated, and misguided. At PRM, our mission is to decrease the time patients are suffering from pelvic pain symptoms. Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine has positioned itself at the center of the pelvic pain ecosystem. We are nationally recognized experts dedicated to reducing the number of people suffering from this affliction. Our unique outpatient, non-operative, minimally invasive ultrasound-guided approach to the pelvis is the first of its kind in the country. Our team focuses on diagnosing and treating chronic pelvic pain in women and men with a procedure that is safe, effective, and more comfortable than what has been offered by pelvic pain providers in the past.

Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine was formed in 2017 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL. Since its inception PRM has experienced rapid growth and routinely attracts patients from across the US and internationally. Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine's fast-paced success has garnered the attention of the investment community positioning it to expand into new markets.

Strong communication skills are essential, as you will engage with multiple stakeholders across different organizations. description:
Store Keeper Job Description

We are looking for an organized, experienced store keeper to be responsible for all stock, staff management, and planning promotional campaigns for the store. Storekeeper is a person who is responsible for goods in a store. Storekeeper is very important person for the store. He is the in charge of store department and also responsible for store control.

Storekeeper Duties & Responsibilities:

• Receive and forward all types of goods and deliveries in and out of the hotel to the correct point of storage area.

• Speak with others using clear and professional language.

• Follow up on documentation of after-hours issues ensuring it is in accordance with established internal controls and procedures.

• Conduct inventory audits to determine inventory levels and needs.

• Assist the Accounts Payable Clerk / payable assistant in finding out any cost discrepancies.

• Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.

• Extend all requisitions on a daily basis and update the inventory management software/system.

• Work closely with Purchasing to order and receive items and equipment.

• Troubleshoot any vendor delivery issues and oversee/follow up on the return process.

• Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs.

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the management or supervisors.

• Bachelor’s degree in retail management, marketing, or related fields

• Well experience in retail management or sales

• Knowledge of retail operations, merchandising, and budgeting processes

• Proven ability to develop and implement retail promotion strategies

• Positive, friendly, and organized

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Proficient in Microsoft Office.

• The ability to work under pressure.

• Availability to work within opening hours (e.g. evenings, holidays, weekends).

This role is critical during revenue-sensitive periods, month-end, quarter-end, where you'll be expected to operate with urgency, precision, and calm under pressure.

Day-to-Day Operations:

  • Monitor service desk tickets intake and triage daily, proactively identifying and resolving failures before they become tickets
  • Own the integration support queue, triaging, prioritising, and resolving tickets with a clear focus on keeping volume consistently low and SLAs tight

  • Communicate clearly and promptly with platform teams (Salesforce Admins, NetSuite Admins, ServiceNow Admins) to co-ordinate cross-platform fixes
  • Act as the primary technical contact for Finance and Sales Operations during data discrepancy escalations, translating technical issues into business-clear updates

Revenue-Period Focus:

  • Maintain a pre-close checklist and execute integration health checks ahead of critical financial periods

  • Document integration maps, error handling logic, and known issue resolutions in a maintained knowledge base
  • Identify patterns in ticket volumes and proactively redesign fragile processes to reduce failure rates
  • Collaborate with the Core Business Systems team on integration enhancements, new connector builds, and platform upgrades

  • Participate in platform team standups and change advisory discussions to flag integration dependencies before deployments
  • Present clear, non-technical updates to business stakeholders during incidents or escalations

  • Integration support ticket volume trending consistently toward zero
  • Zero revenue-impacting data sync failures during month-end and quarter-end close
  • High stakeholder satisfaction scores from Finance and Sales Operations
  • Boomi process failure rate below agreed SLA threshold
  • Maintained, accurate integration documentation and runbooks

#LI-PB1

  • Deep working knowledge of integrations across Salesforce, NetSuite, OpenAir, and ServiceNow

  • Experience working directly with finance teams and sales operations stakeholders to diagnose and resolve data discrepancies
  • Ability to read and interpret platform-side error logs across Salesforce, NetSuite, and ServiceNow
  • Understanding of month-end and quarter-end close processes and the data dependencies they carry

Desirable:

  • Experience with ticket management platforms
  • Exposure to alternative iPaaS platforms
  • Python or scripting skills for lightweight automation and data validation

    • Development Programmes – From Future Managers to Leadership Training, our development programmes help you get where you need to go
    • Online Learning Platform: SkillsHub! - Learning at your fingertips, anytime from anywhere. You can access our online library with relevant content for your career growth.
  • Life Insurance - 3x annual salary
  • Personal Accident Insurance - providing cover in the event of serious injury/illness.
  • Performance Bonus – Our Group-wide bonus scheme enables you to reap the rewards of your success

Who We Are

At OneAdvanced, we are at the forefront of delivering sector-focused technology solutions that simplify complexity, drive meaningful progress, and help build a fairer, more inclusive society.

We’re much more than a software company. We deliver SaaS workflow applications and IT services that power organisations across Education, Government, Healthcare, Legal, Manufacturing, Housing, Retail, and more.

Our secure, scalable platform, including OneAdvanced AI, our private AI service for UK organisations, powers connectivity and innovation across critical sectors. Alongside our software are our IT services, including hosting, managed services, and application modernisation.

We strive to create an inclusive workplace that drives innovation and collaboration, championing diverse perspectives and ideas. Our Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) strategy is embedded in everything we do, guiding us to create meaningful impact for our people, our customers and the planet.

Join us and become part of a team that’s powering the world of work and making a real difference.

title: International CEO
description:
About Alpha Ladder Finance

Alpha Ladder Finance (ALFin) is a Singapore-based, MAS-regulated financial institution operating at the intersection of traditional finance, digital assets and capital markets.

ALFin's business spans areas including capital markets, digital assets, brokerage, custody, RWA tokenisation and institutional financial services. As the company continues its next phase of growth, we are seeking a commercially driven and strategically minded Chief Executive Officer to lead the business, scale its international presence and build a sustainable, institutional-grade financial platform.

Role Overview

The International Chief Executive Officer will have overall responsibility for ALFin's business strategy, commercial growth, financial performance, regulatory positioning and organisational development.

The CEO will work closely with the Board and senior management team to define and execute ALFin's long-term strategy, expand its institutional client and partner ecosystem, develop new markets and products, and strengthen the company's position as a trusted bridge between traditional financial markets and the digital asset economy.

The ideal candidate will bring a strong combination of financial services leadership, commercial execution, regulatory understanding and international market experience, with the ability to operate across traditional finance and emerging digital asset markets.

Key Responsibilities

1. Corporate Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute ALFin's overall corporate strategy in alignment with the Board's vision.

  • Establish clear short-, medium- and long-term business objectives and growth priorities.

  • Lead the organisation through its next phase of growth and international expansion.

  • Develop a scalable and sustainable business model across ALFin's key business lines.

  • Evaluate new business opportunities, markets, products, strategic investments and partnerships.

  • Maintain strong alignment between commercial growth, risk management and regulatory requirements.

2. Business Growth & Commercial Development

  • Drive revenue growth, profitability and overall business performance.

  • Build and scale ALFin's institutional client base across Singapore and international markets.

  • Develop relationships with:

    • Banks and financial institutions

    • Asset managers and institutional investors

    • Family offices

    • Exchanges and trading venues

    • Brokers and liquidity providers

    • Fintech and payment companies

    • Digital asset companies

    • Asset owners and issuers

    • Strategic technology partners

  • Lead high-value strategic negotiations and key institutional relationships.

  • Build a strong international ecosystem to support ALFin's growth.

3. RWA & Digital Asset Strategy

  • Define ALFin's strategic positioning in Real-World Assets (RWA), tokenisation and digital financial markets.

  • Identify opportunities to bring traditional financial assets onto regulated digital infrastructure.

  • Develop relationships with asset owners, issuers, institutional investors, blockchain networks, custodians and technology providers.

  • Evaluate opportunities involving tokenised securities, digital assets, stablecoins and blockchain-enabled financial infrastructure.

  • Ensure innovation remains commercially viable and aligned with regulatory expectations.

4. International Expansion

  • Develop and execute ALFin's international market expansion strategy.

  • Identify priority markets and establish market-entry plans.

  • Build relationships with regulators, financial institutions, strategic partners and industry stakeholders where appropriate.

  • Establish and lead regional business development initiatives.

  • Represent ALFin at major international financial, capital markets and digital asset forums.

  • Position ALFin as a credible and trusted institutional partner globally.

5. Regulatory & Risk Leadership

  • Maintain a strong culture of regulatory compliance and responsible growth.

  • Work closely with Compliance, Legal, Risk and other control functions to ensure business activities remain within applicable regulatory requirements.

  • Ensure commercial initiatives are appropriately assessed from legal, compliance, operational and reputational risk perspectives.

  • Maintain constructive relationships with relevant regulators and industry bodies.

  • Promote strong governance, risk management and internal controls throughout the organisation.

6. Product & Business Development

  • Work with Product and Business teams to develop products aligned with market demand.

  • Identify new opportunities across:

    • Capital markets

    • Digital assets

    • RWA tokenisation

    • Brokerage

    • Custody

    • Institutional trading

    • Financial infrastructure

  • Ensure product strategy is commercially driven and supported by strong customer and market insights.

  • Translate market opportunities into executable business plans.

7. Organisational Leadership

  • Build, develop and retain a high-performing leadership team.

  • Establish a strong performance-driven and entrepreneurial culture.

  • Set clear accountability across business functions.

  • Develop succession planning and leadership development.

  • Ensure the organisation has the capabilities required to support future growth.

  • Champion collaboration across Commercial, Product, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Legal, Risk and Finance.

8. Board & Stakeholder Management

  • Provide the Board with regular updates on strategy, financial performance, business development, risks and key initiatives.

  • Prepare and present annual business plans, budgets and strategic initiatives.

  • Ensure effective communication with shareholders and key stakeholders.

  • Act as the primary senior representative of ALFin with major institutional and strategic partners.

Key Performance Indicators

Business Performance

  • Revenue and profitability growth.

  • Achievement of annual business and financial targets.

  • Growth of institutional client base.

  • New business lines and revenue streams launched.

International Growth

  • Expansion into targeted international markets.

  • Strategic institutional partnerships established.

  • Growth in international revenue and client contribution.

  • Development of ALFin's global ecosystem.

Product & Innovation

  • Successful launch and scaling of strategic products.

  • RWA/tokenisation opportunities originated and converted.

  • Institutional adoption of digital financial products.

Organisation

  • Leadership team effectiveness and talent retention.

  • Execution of strategic initiatives.

  • Organisational scalability and operational efficiency.

Governance

  • Strong regulatory and compliance track record.

  • Effective risk management and governance.

  • Maintenance of ALFin's reputation as a trusted regulated financial institution.

Candidate Profile

Required Experience

  • 15+ years of relevant professional experience, with significant leadership experience in financial services.

  • Proven experience as a CEO, Managing Director, Country Head, Regional Head or senior executive within a financial institution, capital markets firm, fintech or related business.

  • Strong understanding of institutional financial markets and financial services.

  • Demonstrated track record of building and scaling businesses.

  • Proven experience managing P&L, commercial strategy and senior leadership teams.

  • Strong international business and partnership development experience.

  • Experience working within a regulated financial services environment.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas will be strongly preferred:

  • Capital markets

  • Investment banking

  • Brokerage / securities

  • Digital assets

  • Asset management

  • Institutional trading

  • Custody

  • RWA / asset tokenisation

  • Fintech

  • Payments

  • Blockchain / Web3 financial infrastructure

Experience with MAS-regulated businesses or other major global financial regulators is highly advantageous.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Vision – Able to define a compelling long-term strategy while maintaining strong execution discipline.

  • Commercial Acumen – Strong understanding of revenue generation, P&L management and business development.

  • Institutional Credibility – Able to build trust with financial institutions, regulators, investors and senior stakeholders.

  • Execution Excellence – Able to translate strategy into measurable business outcomes.

  • Entrepreneurial Mindset – Comfortable operating in a high-growth and evolving market.

  • Regulatory Mindset – Understands that sustainable growth must be built on strong governance and compliance.

  • International Leadership – Experienced in working across markets and cultures.

  • People Leadership – Able to attract, motivate and develop high-calibre leadership teams.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering or a related discipline.

  • MBA, CFA, professional financial qualification or other relevant advanced qualification is advantageous.

Why Join Alpha Ladder Finance?

This is an opportunity to lead a MAS-regulated financial institution at the intersection of traditional capital markets and the emerging digital asset economy.

The CEO will have the opportunity to shape ALFin's next stage of growth, build a global institutional ecosystem and develop new financial products around RWA tokenisation, digital assets and regulated capital markets infrastructure.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in defining ALFin's position in the rapidly evolving global financial landscape and building the organisation into a scalable, internationally recognised financial platform.

Why Join Alpha Ladder Finance?

ALFin is building infrastructure at the intersection of traditional finance and decentralised finance, combining regulatory credibility with blockchain and financial technology. Its platform supports RWA tokenisation, custody, trading and institutional financial services, creating opportunities to bridge traditional assets with the digital economy.

This is an opportunity for a commercially driven ecosystem builder to play a key role in taking ALFin's capabilities into international markets and shaping the next generation of regulated digital financial infrastructure.

title: Senior / Staff  SLM & VLM Engineer - Post-Training, Tool Calling & Agents
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly capable engineer/researcher to lead the R&D of Small Language Models (SLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for edge / low-latency and cost-efficient production scenarios. You will own the continuous pretraining, supervised instruction tuning (SFT), and compression/distillation pipelines, and work closely with platform teams to deliver reliable, measurable improvements in inference efficiency, tool-use success rate, and overall model quality.

Key Responsibilities

1) SLM/VLM Training: Continuous Pretraining & Instruction Tuning (SFT)

• Conduct continuous pretraining and SFT for SLMs and VLMs to improve task performance and domain adaptation.

• Build reproducible training workflows in PyTorch, including data processing, training, evaluation, and model versioning.

2) Compression, Distillation & Edge/Low-Latency Inference Optimization

• Design and implement efficient compression strategies for SLM/VLM, including knowledge distillation, pruning, and quantization-oriented training or post-training optimization.

• Optimize model serving and inference for low-latency / edge scenarios by improving throughput and cost-per-token via techniques such as quantization, caching/KV optimizations, batching strategies, and decoding-time optimizations.

3) Tool Calling System: Catalog, Routing, Validation, Fallback & Observability

• Architect and implement a production-grade tool calling (function/tool calling) framework:

• Tool cataloging and metadata/schema design

• Tool selection/routing and argument construction

• Parameter validation, result verification, and safe fallback/retry strategies

• Call-chain tracing, monitoring, and observability to improve success rate and ROI

4) RL & Reward Modeling for Alignment and Tool-Use Reliability

• Apply post-training methods such as PPO / DPO / GRPO-like optimization and reward modeling to align the model toward objectives including:

• semantic understanding

• tool-use success rate

• content generation quality and consistency

• Support both offline and online iteration loops, including policy evaluation, regression checks, and safe deployment gating.

5) Data Pipeline Automation (Collection, Cleaning, Curation)

• Design automated pipelines for data collection, filtering, cleaning, de-duplication, labeling/weak supervision, and dataset version management to continuously improve training quality.

• Ensure datasets support both SFT and preference/RL style post-training.

6) Rigorous Evaluation, Testing & Iteration

• Build robust evaluation mechanisms: offline benchmarks, task suites for tool-use, regression tests, and reliability metrics.

• Drive rapid iteration through A/B comparisons, ablations, and failure analysis, improving both quality and efficiency over time.

Required Qualifications

• Strong software engineering skills in Python and C++, including experience building ML training/evaluation pipelines in PyTorch.

• Hands-on experience in model efficiency and inference optimization (e.g., distillation, quantization, pruning, serving optimization).

• Experience with high-performance computing and acceleration: CUDA and/or SIMD, profiling and performance tuning.

• Ability to read and reproduce key ideas from recent papers and implement algorithms with strong experimental discipline.

• Ability to communicate effectively in both Chinese (Mandarin) and English as the successful candidate will have to liaise with our counterparts in China.

description:
About Us:
