Position Description: Production Scheduler


The Production Scheduler is responsible for translating customer demand, production requirements, and material availability into an executable production schedule for each machine or manufacturing work center.


This role balances demand against available machine capacity, labor, tooling, material, and production priorities to ensure work is scheduled efficiently and customer requirements are achieved. The Machine Load Scheduler works closely with Production, Materials, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Operations leadership to identify capacity constraints, prioritize work, and maintain an accurate forward-looking production plan.


Primary Duties:

  • Translate customer demand, sales orders, forecasts, and production requirements into a detailed production schedule by machine and work center.
  • Develop daily, weekly, and monthly machine-loading schedules based on required quantities and due dates.
  • Review available machine capacity and compare it against current and future demand.
  • Identify overloaded and underutilized machines or work centers and recommend actions to balance production.
  • Sequence production orders to maximize machine utilization while minimizing changeovers, setup time, downtime, and production disruptions.
  • Coordinate production priorities with Operations, Materials, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, and Supply Chain.
  • Confirm that materials, tooling, programs, fixtures, drawings, and other production requirements are available before scheduling work.
  • Monitor actual production performance against the scheduled plan and adjust schedules when conditions change.
  • Reschedule production based on equipment downtime, material shortages, quality issues, engineering changes, labor constraints, or changes in customer demand.
  • Maintain visibility of machine utilization, available capacity, backlog, and schedule adherence.
  • Identify potential capacity constraints early and escalate risks that could impact customer delivery.
  • Support capacity planning by providing information regarding required machine hours versus available machine hours.
  • Coordinate with Manufacturing Engineering when alternate machines, processes, routings, or additional capacity may be required.
  • Maintain accurate planning and scheduling information within the ERP/MRP system.
  • Participate in daily production and planning meetings and communicate changes to the production schedule.
  • Support continuous improvement activities related to scheduling, machine utilization, throughput, lead time, and production flow.

title: Head of Service Network, APAC
description:
Envirotainer provides leasing and purchasing services for temperature-controlled (active and advanced passive) containers and parcels used in the global transport of temperature-sensitive pharmaceutical products requiring a strictly controlled environment. The Operations organization consists of key functions including Customer Service, Service Network, Logistics, and Cold Chain Solutions. Together, these functions ensure the availability, reliability, and performance of our active and advanced passive cold chain, securing life-saving pharmaceutical deliveries worldwide.

Service Network: To ensure reliable temperature-controlled solutions around the world, our Service Network are the key players when it comes to the training in handling and inspections of our products. They ensure our partners can deliver fully functional products when the customer needs them. At the global stations within our network, of which SIN, ICN, AMS, ATL, & ARN are our own Envirotainer stations, training and operational efficiency improvement is continuously ongoing. Service Network is represented in Singapore, Germany and United States of Americas regional offices.

As Head of Service Network, you are responsible for the performance management of Envirotainer’ s network of outsourced stations within the region, which in turn ensures that our products are handled efficiently and cost-effectively.

Station Performance Management

Visit stations with frequencies depending on station importance to monitor station performance as well as improve Service Level Agreement (SLA)compliance, including frequent contact with management counterparts at our service network stations (Quarterly Business Review Meetings). Your tasks also include benchmarking station performance within your region as well as planning and ensuring 100% fulfillment of performance reviews for stations. Closely supported by your Service Network Manager, your tasks also include conducting performance reviews for individual stations and following up persistently. You actively monitor the station KPI scoreboard, including daily follow-up to encourage better performance for stations (“hot spot” stations). Escalation of tasks to central HQ if not solvable locally is expected and to be performed together with VP Operations APAC. Key metrics are Mean Time To Repair, Damages follow-up, Non conformities (quality).

Financial Controlling

Track station costs against expectations and review reports on station financial performance; you are supported in this work by a Controller within APAC Finance department. Your duties also include approving or rejecting invoices from stations. At regular intervals, your input will also be sought on how to strengthen internal controls in conjunction with APAC Finance.

Station Capabilities

Forecast future station capacity and capabilities needs based on historical trends, and provide suggestions on upgrades and/or downgrades in your region to APAC Management. You will be required to participate and provide inputs in regional Sales and Operations meetings as well as cross-functional meetings between departments.

Process Improvements and Training

Continuously work with all stations to improve on-station processes (Lean, Flow) for ground handling, container repairs, and related tasks. Provide input to global Envirotainer functions on process improvement needs, as well as work with global Envirotainer functions to improve on-station processes. You will at times be required to conduct trainings at stations, perform customer visits in combination with your station visits.

Professional Capabilities

  • Good communication skills (English, both spoken and written, as well as presentation skills)
  • Cultural sensitivity and awareness in all communications
  • Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Office and internet-based tools
  • Experience and ability to constructively manage outsourced service providers
  • Tenacious and persistent in following up supplier compliance
  • Independent, thorough and timely execution of areas of responsibility
  • Command of process analysis techniques
  • Command of benchmarking techniques
  • Strong skills in usage and requirement specifications for IT tools
  • Ability to conduct trainings and drive change on stations
  • Ability to communicate our expectations and demands to our external partners, while effectively managing disagreements that may arise

  • Experience from the logistics industry, ULD industry, transportation industry (air freight/airline), and/or an industry with a global service network as a core component
  • Project management experience/Lean background is preferred
  • Previous international/APAC experience and willingness to operate in APAC region

title: Human Resource & Admin Executive
description:
We are seeking a well-organised, people-oriented, and detail-focused HR & Admin Executive to support the company's human resources and administrative functions. The role will be responsible for HR administration, recruitment, employee records, payroll coordination, staff engagement, office administration, and operational support. The ideal candidate should be hands-on, dependable, discreet, and comfortable working in a fast-paced food & beverage environment with a mix of office and outlet-based employees. The HR & Admin Executive plays a key role in ensuring that the company has the right people, processes, and administrative support to operate effectively. The role combines HR administration ×recruitment × employee support × payroll coordination × compliance × office administration, with a strong focus on accuracy, responsiveness, confidentiality, and employee experience.

Key Responsibilities

1. HR Administration

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date employee records, personal particulars, employment documents, and HR files.
  • Prepare employment contracts, confirmation letters, staff notices, and other HR-related documents.
  • Maintain records of staff attendance, leave, medical leave, training, disciplinary matters, and other employee information.
  • Ensure HR documentation is complete, properly filed, and handled with confidentiality.
  • Support the implementation and administration of company HR policies and procedures.
  • Respond to employees' HR-related enquiries and provide timely assistance.

2. Recruitment & Onboarding

  • Coordinate recruitment activities for service crew, supervisors, managers, and head-office positions.
  • Post job advertisements through appropriate recruitment channels.
  • Screen applications and shortlist suitable candidates.
  • Coordinate interviews and communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process.
  • Prepare employment documentation and coordinate pre-employment requirements.
  • Conduct or coordinate new employee onboarding and orientation.
  • Ensure new employees receive the necessary information, uniforms, systems access, and training arrangements.
  • Maintain recruitment records and monitor manpower vacancies.

3. Payroll & Attendance Administration

  • Coordinate monthly payroll preparation and ensure accurate submission of payroll information.
  • Maintain attendance, overtime, leave, unpaid leave, allowances, deductions, and other payroll-related records.
  • Work closely with management and payroll providers to resolve discrepancies.
  • Verify staff attendance and overtime records with Store and Area Managers.
  • Maintain accurate payroll documentation and ensure confidentiality of employee salary information.
  • Support the administration of statutory contributions and employment-related requirements where applicable.

4. Employee Relations& Engagement

  • Serve as a first point of contact for routine employee HR matters.
  • Support managers in handling employee concerns, grievances, attendance issues, and workplace matters.
  • Assist with disciplinary and performance management processes in accordance with company policies.
  • Coordinate staff communication, announcements, and HR initiatives.
  • Organise employee engagement activities, staff welfare initiatives, and company events.
  • Promote a positive, respectful, and supportive workplace culture.
  • Identify recurring employee issues and highlight them to management.

5. Training &Development

  • Coordinate employee training programmes and maintain training records.
  • Support onboarding and operational training for new staff.
  • Work with Operations Managers to identify training needs.
  • Coordinate external training providers where required.
  • Monitor completion of mandatory training and certifications.
  • Maintain an updated employee skills and training database.

6. Performance Management

  • Support the administration of employee probation and confirmation processes.
  • Coordinate performance review schedules and documentation.
  • Track employee performance review completion.
  • Assist managers with performance improvement documentation where required.
  • Maintain appropriate records of employee development and performance-related activities.

7. Staff Welfare & Benefits

  • Administer employee benefits, staff discounts, uniforms, and other welfare programmes.
  • Coordinate employee insurance or medical benefit administration where applicable.
  • Support staff welfare matters and assist employees with benefit-related enquiries.
  • Maintain accurate records of employee benefits and entitlements.

8. Office & Administrative Support

  • Manage day-to-day office administration and ensure the office operates smoothly.
  • Coordinate office supplies, equipment, stationery, and general administrative requirements.
  • Maintain proper filing and documentation systems.
  • Coordinate meetings, appointments, internal communications, and company activities.
  • Liaise with suppliers, contractors, service providers, and external parties when required.
  • Support company events, meetings, training sessions, and other administrative activities.
  • Assist management with reports, presentations, documentation, and other administrative tasks.

9. Outlet & Operations Support

  • Provide HR and administrative support to food kiosk outlets.
  • Coordinate manpower-related matters with Store Managers and Area Managers.
  • Assist with staff deployment, transfers, onboarding, and outlet manpower requirements.
  • Ensure outlet staff receive timely HR communication and support.
  • Conduct periodic outlet visits where required to understand employee and administrative needs.
  • Support operational teams in implementing HR policies and procedures consistently.

10. HR Compliance & Confidentiality

  • Ensure HR practices and documentation comply with applicable employment requirements and company policies.
  • Maintain strict confidentiality of employee personal, payroll, and employment information.
  • Keep HR policies, forms, and employee documentation properly updated.
  • Monitor important employment-related dates such as probation, work permits, certifications, and contract renewals where applicable.
  • Escalate sensitive or complex HR matters to management promptly.

11. HR Reporting& Analysis

  • Prepare regular HR reports covering:
  • Headcount
  • Staff turnover
  • Recruitment status
  • Attendance and absenteeism
  • Overtime
  • Leave utilisation
  • Training
  • Employee costs
  • Monitor manpower trends and highlight areas requiring management attention.
  • Provide HR data and insights to support workforce planning and business decisions.
  • Maintain accurate and timely HR dashboards and records.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Management, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of HR and administrative experience.
  • Experience in food & beverage, retail, hospitality, or other high-volume workforce environments is an advantage.
  • Experience supporting frontline or shift-based employees is preferred.
  • Good knowledge of HR administration, recruitment, payroll coordination, and employee relations.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • High level of integrity and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Good attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Able to work independently while also collaborating effectively with Operations and Management.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience with HRIS, payroll, attendance, or scheduling systems is an advantage.

Working Conditions

  • Full-time position
  • Primarily office-based with occasional visits to food kiosk outlets
  • May require occasional work outside normal office hours to support recruitment, staff onboarding, training, or company events
  • May require weekend work when operational or recruitment activities require it

What We Offer

  • Training and professional development opportunities
  • Exposure to both HR and business operations
  • Career progression opportunities
  • Dynamic working environment within a growing food & beverage business
  • Opportunity to work closely with Operations and Management

I. POSITION SUMMARY

A. Operates, monitors, and assists in the drying and finishing processes, which involve the drying; the automated cutting; the visual inspecting; and the manual stacking of dried, formed products. Those products are supplied to the kiln area where they are fired in kilns, in which ceramic products are produced that meet the required specifications & quality standards.

C. Inspects greenbody wooden pallet for damage; confirms that both sides of the wooden pallet have the same pallet number; and places finishing pallet cart on table lift in a safe and efficient manner.

D. Calculates and verifies the number of layers and pieces of greenbody per layer for each travel ticket quantity.

E. Picks up the product that is deposited onto the finishing table by the third transfer; applies part specific visual criteria understanding to visually inspect the entirety of each part; and places the approved parts onto the pallet in the proper manner

F. Places white cardboard between each layer of greenbody, using the proper technique; when proper amount of product has been placed on finishing pallet, lowers cart and rolls cart to a location where the pallet may be easily removed by the forklift; and places the Finishing Travel Ticket on the finished pallet.

G. Enters complete and accurate process information into the company’s information systems.

H. Determines maximum allowable values for dimensional characteristics (perpendicularity and length) by referencing the Target Sheet; checks length and perpendicularity; and determines location and magnitude of maximum perpendicularity variance by using the proper test timing.

I. Calculates accepted, rejected and handled part quantities; performs yield/defect rate
calculations; and calculates the number of total cuts on a specific blade and/or sets of blades and records the required information.

J. Segregates and stacks/disposes of shiro-modori; wraps pallet and completely and accurately fills out the modori tag.

title: Senior Accounts Executive
description:
OneEmpower is looking for a Senior Accounts Executive – Accounts Receivable to join our Finance team in Singapore.

The role is responsible for generalist accounting, accounts receivable, and billing activities, with particular focus on customer invoicing, recurring maintenance and licence billing, collections, reconciliations, and billing status reporting.

You will work closely with stakeholders across the business to ensure billing information is complete and accurate, resolve outstanding issues, and provide timely visibility of billing and collection status. The role will also support the finance team in its ongoing transformation, including process improvements and a potential future accounting system migration.

This is a hands-on role requiring strong Excel and data manipulation skills, attention to detail, adaptability, and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end accounts receivable process, including invoicing, receipt allocation, collections and reconciliation of customer balances.
  • Coordinate and prepare recurring billings, including annual maintenance, software licenses, and other contractual billings.
  • Maintain billing schedules and trackers to ensure billing status, upcoming billings, outstanding items, and required follow-ups are accurately captured.
  • Prepare and circulate regular billing status updates, including periodic summaries of maintenance and license billing, to management and relevant stakeholders.
  • Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain billing information, supporting documentation, and confirmation required before invoices are issued.
  • Monitor accounts receivable aging and follow up proactively on overdue invoices and outstanding balances.
  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies, unapplied receipts, and other customer account issues.
  • Perform accounts receivable and general ledger reconciliations and support month-end and year-end closing.
  • Prepare AR aging, billing, collection, and other financial reports as required by the Head of Accounting.
  • Use Excel extensively to manipulate, reconcile, and analyze financial and operational data, including identifying missing information, discrepancies, and exceptions.
  • Maintain and improve existing Excel-based billing schedules, reconciliations, and reporting templates.
  • Perform day-to-day accounting activities using FACT ERP.NG and ensure accounting records are complete and accurate.
  • Support finance process improvements and changes to existing workflows and controls.
  • Participate in any future accounting system migration, including data extraction, cleansing, mapping, reconciliation, testing, and validation.
  • Work with finance and non-finance stakeholders to resolve issues and drive matters through to completion with minimal supervision.
  • Assist with the annual external audit, including preparation of schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and responses to auditor queries.
  • Support other accounting and finance activities as required by the Head of Accounting.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
  • Relevant hands-on experience in accounts receivable, billing, or a similar accounting role.
  • Good understanding of the end-to-end billing and accounts receivable cycle.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel proficiency is mandatory and non-negotiable. Candidates must be comfortable manipulating and reconciling data independently, including using PivotTables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, SUMIFS, IF functions, filters, and other relevant Excel tools.
  • Hands-on proficiency with FACT ERP.NG is required.
  • Comfortable working with financial data from multiple sources and independently investigating discrepancies.
  • Good understanding of accounting principles, reconciliations, and month-end closing processes.
  • Strong attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and recurring deadlines.
  • Demonstrates a proactive mindset towards emerging technologies, including AI, and is willing to adopt and integrate appropriate AI tools into day-to-day finance, reporting, and data-related work to improve efficiency, accuracy, and productivity.
  • Able to work independently, take ownership of assigned matters, and follow issues through to resolution with minimal supervision.
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across different functions.
  • Highly adaptable and comfortable with changing processes, systems, and responsibilities as the business undergoes transformation.
  • Comfortable participating in accounting system migration and process improvement initiatives.
  • This is a Singapore-based role, and candidates must be able to work under the company's hybrid working arrangement.

title: Cluster Coordinator iWork- Harar
description:
Who we are

SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia is an International Non-governmental organization and a member of SOS Children’s Villages International Federation. We started our humanitarian work in Ethiopia with the opening of our first Village in Mekelle, Northern part of Ethiopia in 1974. Since then, we have expanded our programs to different regions where there are significant needs for intervention and where we believe we can work in partnership with all relevant actors to bring sustainable positive outcomes for children’s and young people.

Today, we have grown significantly to meet the persistent challenges that confront Ethiopian children who have lost parental care and those that are at risk of losing their parental care. Working in close collaboration with international donors, local government and community-based organizations across eight program locations; we aspire that every child grows up with love, respect and security.

Want to know more about life at SOS?

🌟 Explore our Employee Value Proposition Here

👉 Follow our journey on LinkedIn

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

At SOS Children's Villages, safeguarding isn't just a policy, it's a foundational value embedded in everything we do. We are unwavering in our commitment to protecting the children, young people, adults, and communities we serve, as well as our workforce and resources.

We cultivate an environment of trust and accountability where every voice is heard and respected. All successful candidates will be expected to champion our holistic safeguarding principles, actively upholding our Child & Youth Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct, and regulations against sexual misconduct, fraud, and corruption.

By joining our team, you commit to integrating these vital standards into your work, ensuring the highest levels of safety, ethics, and integrity in every action and partnership.

Together, we create a world where everyone feels safe, respected, and protected

Join Our Mission:

We are looking for a Proactive Cluster Coordinator to work under the supervision of the Location Program Director, being responsible for the overall coordination, planning, implementation, monitoring, quality assurance, and reporting of the iWork Programme within the assigned cluster. The role ensures effective delivery of interventions under the programme’s three pillars: Workforce Development, Host Institution Facilitation, and Ecosystem Strengthening.The position leads engagement with government institutions, private sector employers, TVET institutions, One-Stop Service Centers (OSS), and other ecosystem actors to facilitate quality internship opportunities for young women and disadvantaged groups as a pathway to employment and economic participation.The incumbent ensures that programme implementation complies with SOS Children's Villages policies and procedures, donor requirements, safeguarding standards, and national regulations. is responsible for the overall coordination, planning, implementation, monitoring, quality assurance, and reporting of the iWork Programme within the assigned cluster. The role ensures effective delivery of interventions under the programme’s three pillars: Workforce Development, Host Institution Facilitation, and Ecosystem Strengthening.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Development

  • Coordinate the identification, mobilization, registration, screening, and onboarding of eligible young women and other vulnerable youth for programme participation.

  • Oversee participant profiling, career assessment, employability preparation, and life skills training to improve workforce readiness.

  • Monitor participant progress throughout the internship cycle and facilitate successful transition pathways into employment, entrepreneurship, or further learning opportunities.

  • Promote equitable participation and inclusion of women, persons with disabilities, refugees, internally displaced persons, and other marginalized groups across programme activities.

  • Verify participant attendance, internship completion records, and stipend documentation to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant stipend administration.

Host Institution Facilitation

  • Lead the identification, assessment, onboarding, and relationship management of host institutions across public, private, and civil society sectors.

  • Ensure host institutions comply with programme standards, safeguarding requirements, workplace ethics, accessibility, and inclusion policies.

  • Coordinate intern matching, placement, partnership agreements, internship contracts, and standard operating procedures to ensure quality internship experiences.

  • Monitor internship implementation through field visits, mentorship follow-up, performance reviews, and timely resolution of workplace challenges affecting interns and host organizations.

  • Conduct capacity assessments and coordinate technical training for host institutions on coaching, mentoring, safeguarding, gender equality, disability inclusion, workplace ethics, and conflict-sensitive business practices.

  • Provide ongoing technical assistance and follow-up support to strengthen host institutions' capacity to deliver inclusive, high-quality internship opportunities.

  • Conduct regular quality assurance visits, spot checks, and participant satisfaction assessments to maintain high standards of internship delivery and participant welfare.

Ecosystem Strengthening

  • Lead the planning, implementation, and periodic review of cluster-level programme activities in alignment with approved work plans, budgets, donor agreements, and organizational policies.

  • Develop annual operational plans, implementation schedules, and resource allocation plans to ensure effective programme delivery across the cluster.

  • Coordinate integrated implementation across programme pillars to achieve programme targets, milestones, and quality outcomes.

  • Facilitate regular planning, coordination, and performance review meetings with project teams and key stakeholders to strengthen programme effectiveness.

  • Identify programme implementation risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures to minimize operational disruptions.

  • Strengthen collaboration with OSS centres, TVET institutions, universities, community structures, and referral partners to expand participant outreach and engagement.

  • Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, private sector employers, educational institutions, and development partners to strengthen internship ecosystems and labour market linkages.

  • Represent the programme in coordination forums, technical working groups, stakeholder engagement events, and policy dialogue initiatives related to youth employment and workforce development.

  • Ensure full compliance with safeguarding, gender equality, disability inclusion, and organizational protection standards across all programme activities and partnerships.

  • Monitor programme performance by ensuring accurate data collection, indicator tracking, documentation, reporting, and application of evidence for adaptive programme management.

  • Manage programme budgets, procurement processes, assets, and financial resources in accordance with donor requirements and organizational financial policies.

  • Review budget utilization, expenditure trends, forecasts, and financial reports to support effective resource management and accountability.

Our Ideal Candidate?

Let's find out if we're a match. The next step in our process depends on how your background closely align with the below criteria’s.

Essential Requirements (Must-Have):

Education:

Master’s degree in development studies, Economics, Business Administration, Project Management, Sociology, Social Work, Education, Labour Studies, or related fields.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 (Five) years of relevant professional experience in youth employment, workforce development, internship programmes, TVET, livelihoods, private sector engagement, or economic empowerment programmes.
  • Minimum of 3 (Three) years of the total relevant experience must be in project coordination or management roles.
  • Experience managing donor-funded programmes is required.

Role Specific Competencies:

  • Project Cycle Management (PCM): Ability to sequence activities logically, adjust plans in response to performance data, and reallocate resources effectively to stay on track.
  • Youth Employment and Workforce Development: Skill in applying labour market knowledge to assess intervention relevance and adjust approaches to improve actual placement outcomes.
  • Internship Programme Management: Capability to systematically monitor placement quality, resolve workplace issues impartially, and uphold participant welfare across all internship stages.
  • Partnership and Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence diverse actors, negotiate mutually beneficial arrangements, and maintain sustained engagement through consistent communication.
  • Labour Market Systems Development: Skill in analysing local employment ecosystems and facilitating durable connections between supply-side training and employer demand.
  • Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL): Capacity to critically interpret indicator data, translate findings into practical corrective actions, and promote team-wide use of evidence for decision-making.
  • Financial and Budget Management: Ability to track expenditure trends, identify variances early, and exercise sound judgment in resource reallocation to ensure donor compliance and value-for-money.
  • Safeguarding and Protection: Behavioural commitment to proactively identify risks, handle disclosures with confidentiality, and consistently model protective practices that influence others.
  • Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI): Skill in recognising and countering exclusionary biases, adapting outreach methods for marginalised groups, and holding partners accountable to equitable participation.
  • Private Sector Engagement: Capability to articulate clear business value propositions, negotiate credible placement agreements, and respond flexibly to shifting employer requirements.
  • Reporting and Documentation: Skill in synthesising complex programme data into concise, accurate, and well-structured narratives that meet donor expectations and internal review standards.

Desired Assets (Nice-to-Have):

  • Hands-on experience in donor engagement, public‑private partnerships, TVET systems, youth employment programming, policy advocacy.
  • Proficiency in local languages of the project implementing areas.

SOS Lead and Core Competencies

Lead Competency

  • Role model: Act as a role model for the organization, living our values and inspiring and learning from others
  • Collaboration: Remove barriers to participation, share decision making and build partnerships
  • Empowerment: Promote inclusion and equitable sharing of power
  • Strategic Thinking: Live the values and mission, setting realistic goals and translating them into actionable plans

Core Competency

  • Kindness: Act with empathy towards everyone he/she works with.
  • Continuous Learning: Make an effort to learn, understand and grow as a person, admitting your own mistakes.
  • Inclusiveness: In any actions show respect and care for others.
  • Initiative: speak up when things are not right, do not hesitate to act, and adapt to change when necessary.
  • Results Orientation: look for solutions and focus on desired results.

Does This Sound Like You?

To apply, please submit your updated resume via SOS Children's Villages Application portal (ICIMS)

We actively champion diversity and inclusion and strongly encourage women to step forward and apply. As part of our unwavering commitment to holistic safeguarding protecting children, youth, adults, and assets our selection process emphasizes value alignment and includes thorough background checks for all potential hires.

SOS Children's Villages in Ethiopia is an equal opportunity employer, providing fair consideration to all applicant regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, marital status, or class.

title: Senior AI Engineer

description:
About ST Engineering

ST Engineering is a global technology, defence, and engineering group with offices across Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and the U.S., serving customers in more than 100 countries. The Group uses technology and innovation to solve real-world problems and improve lives through its diverse portfolio of businesses across the aerospace, smart city, defence, and public security segments. Headquartered in Singapore, ST Engineering ranks among the largest companies listed on the Singapore Exchange.

Our history spans more than 50 years, and our strategy is underpinned by our core values – Integrity, Value Creation, Courage, Commitment and Compassion. These 5 core values guide every aspect of our business and are embedded in our ST Engineering culture – from the people we hire, to working with each other, to our partners and customers.

About our Line of Business – Mission Software & Services

Our Mission Software & Services business provides leading-edge mission critical command, control, and communications (C3) systems with secured IT infrastructure and managed services. We support our client’s innovation journey through design thinking, analytics, and AI-enabled decision support with our full suite of cloud computing solutions. We provide intelligent, actionable insights and sustainable solutions to our valued partners in diverse industries including defence, government, and commercial sectors.

Together, We Can Make A Significant Impact

We are seeking an experienced Senior AI Engineer (Agentic AI & Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to join our dynamic team. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, developing, and deploying next-generation AI systems powered by Large Language Models (LLMs), Agentic AI frameworks, multi-agent systems, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures. Your expertise will contribute to the delivery of mission-critical AI solutions that transform how organizations access knowledge, automate workflows, and augment human decision-making.

Be Part of Our Success

  • Design, develop, and deploy Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), planning agents, tool-using agents, and multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
  • Design and implement Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that integrate enterprise knowledge bases, vector databases, document repositories, and external data sources.
  • Collaborate with customers, domain experts, and stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-enabled solutions and intelligent workflows.
  • Develop AI microservices, APIs, and backend services to support scalable deployment of generative AI and agentic applications.
  • Build and optimize document ingestion, indexing, embedding, retrieval, reranking, and knowledge-grounding pipelines.
  • Evaluate, select, and integrate state-of-the-art LLMs, foundation models, embeddings models, and AI agent frameworks.
  • Design prompts, agent workflows, tool chains, and memory management mechanisms to improve AI system accuracy and user experience.
  • Implement model evaluation, benchmarking, guardrails, observability, and monitoring mechanisms to ensure reliability, safety, and performance.
  • Collaborate with software engineers and DevSecOps teams to deploy AI solutions into production environments using CI/CD best practices.
  • Optimize AI system performance, latency, scalability, and operational costs.
  • Conduct proof-of-concepts, technology evaluations, and experiments on emerging AI technologies and frameworks.
  • Support pre-sales activities, proposal development, technical presentations, and customer demonstrations.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in AI engineering, software development, and solution architecture.
  • Stay abreast of recent developments in Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG architectures, multimodal AI, and AI engineering practices.

Qualities We Value

  • Shall have at least three (3) years of hands-on implementation and deployment experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, or generative AI solutions.
  • Strong experience in Python programming and software engineering best practices.
  • Practical experience developing and deploying LLM-powered applications using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, or equivalent.
  • Experience designing and implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge retrieval pipelines.
  • Familiarity with modern LLMs and foundation models from OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, or equivalent ecosystems.
  • Experience integrating AI solutions with structured and unstructured enterprise data sources, document repositories, APIs, and knowledge management systems.
  • Strong knowledge of prompt engineering, model evaluation, fine-tuning, agent orchestration, and AI workflow design.
  • Experience with cloud-native AI development on Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with containerisation and orchestration technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Microservices Architecture.
  • Knowledge of DevSecOps methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.
  • Familiarity with databases and vector stores such as PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Milvus, Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, or Azure AI Search.
  • Preferably have completed at least one (1) project using Scrum or equivalent Agile development framework.
  • Experience in AI governance, responsible AI, model risk management, or AI assurance practices would be advantageous.

title: Commercial Construction Technician
description:
Weekly Pay | Certification-Based Pay Increases | Bonuses | Benefits


Why Work at Beck Suppliers

Beck Suppliers is a 100% employee-owned company where culture comes first. Across our four business divisions, we share a commitment to respect, accountability, and teamwork.

Employee ownership means shared responsibility and shared success - including a retirement benefit that grows over time to support your future financial security, alongside pay and benefits that support you today.


About Beck Fuel Systems

Beck Fuel Systems is part of the Beck Suppliers family and provides fuel system design, installation, maintenance, and removal services across Ohio. Our teams support active job sites including convenience stores, service stations, industrial facilities, and government locations.

This is hands-on, field-based work where safety, teamwork, and doing the job right matter every day.


The Role

The Construction Technician is a hands-on role supporting new builds, remodels, fuel system installations, and facility upgrades. This position works closely with project managers, contractors, and internal teams to complete work safely, efficiently, and to Company standards.

What We’re Looking For

  • Someone who takes pride in hands-on work and doing the job right
  • A safety-focused team member who follows procedures and looks out for others on the job site
  • Dependable and reliable - someone crews and project managers can count on
  • Comfortable working in active construction and job-site environments
  • Able to follow plans, instructions, and established standards with attention to detail
  • Willing to learn new skills and support different types of projects as needed
  • Works well as part of a team and communicates clearly and respectfully
  • Construction, fuel systems, or related trade experience is a plus, but not required for the right candidate


Job Summary/Purpose

The Construction Technician performs hands-on construction, renovation, maintenance, and improvement of convenience stores and other fuel system-related locations. This role performs hands-on work across new store builds, remodel projects, site work, fuel system installations, equipment installations, and facility upgrades to ensure projects meet Company standards for safety, functionality, and quality.

The Construction Technician works closely with the Project Manager, contractors, and internal teams to complete projects safely, efficiently, and within established timelines and budgets.


Key Responsibilities


1. Construction & Store Development

  • Assists with construction, remodel, and maintenance projects at new and existing project sites.
  • Performs general construction tasks including carpentry, drywall repair, painting, flooring installation and repair, fixture installation, and finish work.
  • Performs demolition activities for existing structures and fuel systems.
  • Performs site work activities including utility installation, grading functions, and paving.
  • Performs all aspects of fuel system installations.
  • Performs concrete work including demolition and installation of paving and footers.
  • Assists with site preparation activities including demolition, material staging, and job site organization.
  • Works alongside contractors to install exterior components including signage, bollards, fueling canopies, and site furnishings.
  • Assists with punch list completion.
  • Ensures Company standards and construction specifications are maintained across all projects.

2. Facility

  • Installs and replaces lighting, doors, ceiling systems, and interior finishes.
  • Performs plumbing and electrical work within scope of training and licensing requirements.
  • Coordinates equipment deliveries and verifies materials received match project requirements.
  • Troubleshoots and performs repairs to construction-related issues identified during or after project completion.

3. Project Execution & Field Operations

  • Travels to assigned store locations to perform construction and repair work as scheduled.
  • Works closely with Project Manager, Facilities team, and contractors to complete assigned tasks.
  • Maintains project timelines by completing assigned work efficiently and communicating delays or issues promptly.
  • Reads and follows work orders, construction drawings, layouts, and installation instructions.
  • Maintains clean, safe, and organized job sites to minimize disruption to store operations.
  • Assists contractors and vendors to ensure adherence to Company standards and scope requirements.
  • Participates in store walkthroughs before and after construction activities.

4. Safety & Compliance

  • Follows all Company safety policies, OSHA requirements, and construction site safety procedures.
  • Properly uses personal protective equipment (PPE) at all times.
  • Identifies and reports unsafe conditions, hazards, or code compliance concerns.
  • Ensures tools and equipment are operated safely and maintained in proper working condition.
  • Completes safety inspections and corrective actions as directed.

5. Materials, Tools & Documentation

  • Maintains inventory of tools, materials, and supplies assigned to projects.
  • Loads, transports, and organizes construction materials between job sites.
  • Documents completed work, repairs, and installation activities as required.
  • Tracks material usage and communicates replenishment needs to supervisor.
  • Maintains Company vehicles, tools, and equipment in clean and operational condition.

6. General

title: Research Engineer (Accelerated Cleaning Development and Changeover) - IV2
description:
As a University of Applied Learning, SIT works closely with industry in our research pursuits. Our research staff will have the opportunity to be equipped with applied research skill sets that are relevant to industry demands while working on research projects in SIT.

The successful candidate will contribute to the design, development, fabrication, and validation of an advanced chemical cleaning rig for pharmaceutical and chemical engineering applications. The role focuses on engineering design, fluid dynamics, process calculations, equipment integration, and hands-on experimental validation.

Key Responsibilities
1. Participate in the design, development and optimisation of novel cleaning systems and associated equipment for pharmaceutical applications.

2. Perform engineering calculations related to fluid flow, spray cleaning, pressure losses, hydraulic performance, jet impingement, momentum transfer and hydraulic jump (Froude number) analysis.

3. Develop engineering drawings, specifications and fabrication requirements for custom components.

4. Coordinate with vendors, workshops and fabricators for manufacture, procurement and assembly of experimental equipment.

5. Lead technical discussions with project stakeholders regarding system design material and equipment selection.

6. Plan and execute laboratory experiments to evaluate cleaning effectiveness and process performance.

7. Collect, analyse and interpret experimental data and prepare technical reports.

8. Troubleshoot equipment, instrumentation and process issues during experimental campaigns.

9. Coordinate procurement activities and maintain project documentation.

10. Carry out risk assessments and ensure compliance with Work, Safety and Health (WSH) regulations.

11. Contribute to publications, conference presentations and project deliverables.

12. The candidate is to communicate with all relevant internal and external stakeholders as required to meet the project deliverables.

13. Any other adhoc duties assigned by supervisor.

Key Requirements
• Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Pharmaceutical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
• 2 to 5 years of relevant industrial or research experience preferred.
• Demonstrable experience in process equipment design, prototyping, pilot plants, laboratory systems or pharmaceutical cleaning and/or changeover operations is advantageous.
• Strong knowledge of fluid mechanics, transport phenomena, material and chemical compatibility.
• Experience with process calculations and engineering design with applications in pharmaceutical contexts.
• Familiarity with pumps, piping systems, valves, spray nozzles and process instrumentation to build prototypes.
• Experience with CAD software (SolidWorks, Fusion360, AutoCAD or equivalent)
• Experience working with vendors and equipment fabrication.
• Ability to independently conduct laboratory experimentation involving handling of chemicals.
• Experience in Computational Fluid Dynamics is advantageous.

Key Competencies
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Ability to translate engineering concepts into practical solutions.
• Excellent technical communication and documentation skills.
• Self-motivated and able to work independently.
• Strong organisational and project management abilities.

We are looking for a Workplace Safety & Health Officer to support project site safety management and ensure compliance with Workplace Safety & Health requirements.

title: Engineer II - L2 SOC
description:

(3 to 5 years of experience)

  • Conduct phishing email analysis, including:

o Header and sender analysis

o URL and attachment inspection

o Identification of credential‑harvesting and malware delivery attempts

  • Track and investigate malware alerts, performing basic static and behavioral analysis using EDR telemetry and sandbox results.
  • Monitor and analyze endpoint activity using EDR tools such as Sentinel One and Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
  • Support vulnerability assessment activities by reviewing scan results, validating findings, and assisting with remediation tracking.
  • Maintain accurate incident reports, investigation notes, and SOC documentation.
  • Follow daily threat intelligence updates and apply relevant insights to ongoing investigations.
  • Adherent to SOC SLAs, escalation procedures, and operational best practices
  • Support client Baseline Security Reviews by reviewing security tool configurations and documenting gaps against defined security baselines.

Technology skills and Competencies:

  • Basic to intermediate understanding of networking, security, and system administration concepts.
  • Knowledge of:
  • Network security fundamentals
  • Firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM to
  • Vulnerability assessment concepts and security best practices
  • Familiarity with Windows and/or Linux environments.
  • Hands‑on exposure to:
  • SIEM monitoring and alert investigation
  • Incident response and alert triage
  • Endpoint detection and response (EDR) tools •
  • Understanding of common attack techniques including phishing, malware, brute force, and credential abuse.

Certifications:

  • CEH (Certified Ethical Hacker)
  • Microsoft SC‑200 – Security Operations Analyst
  • Microsoft SC‑900 or equivalent security fundamentals certification

Qualifications and experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
  • Exposure to SOC operations
  • Exposure to Cybersecurity monitoring
  • Hands‑on experience with SIEM tools and security alert investigation is preferred.

title: M01 - Product Manager / Business Analyst
description:
We are looking for a GIS Business Analyst / Product Manager to bridge the gap between geospatial technology and business needs. You will work closely with stakeholders, data teams, and developers to define, deliver, and continuously improve GIS-enabled products and solutions that support decision-making across the organisation.

Responsibilities

  • Gather and translate business requirements into clear product specifications and user stories for GIS applications and spatial data platforms, working with technical teams to design workflows, data models, and map-based interfaces that meet user needs.
  • Manage the product backlog, prioritise features, and ensure timely delivery of GIS solutions in an agile environment as the product owner.
  • Conduct user research, stakeholder interviews, and usability testing to inform product direction and validate design decisions.
  • Analyse spatial datasets to surface insights, identify trends, and support evidence-based planning, using tools such as ArcGIS, QGIS, or similar platforms, and collaborating with data engineers on ETL pipelines and spatial databases.
  • Drive adoption by developing training materials, documentation, and change management plans to help users get the most out of GIS tools.

What We're Looking For

  • Degree in Geography, Urban Planning, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, with at least three to five years of experience in GIS, business analysis, or product management.
  • Hands-on experience with GIS platforms (e.g. Esri ArcGIS, QGIS, MapboxGL) is essential, and familiarity with spatial SQL, Python, or web mapping technologies is a strong advantage.
  • Comfortable working across both technical and non-technical audiences, with strong communication and facilitation skills.
  • Experience in an agile product environment and familiarity with tools like Jira or Confluence.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications in GIS or geospatial technologies, such as Esri Technical Certifications (e.g. ArcGIS Desktop, Enterprise, or Developer), SSSI or similar surveying and spatial science credentials, or cloud platform certifications relevant to GIS deployments (e.g. AWS).
  • Familiarity with observability and monitoring practices for web-based GIS applications, including experience with application performance monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of data governance frameworks, spatial data standards (e.g. OGC standards, ISO 19100 series), or experience with policy and compliance automation in a geospatial context.
  • A background in software development or systems integration, with an appreciation for secure coding practices and how they apply to geospatial platforms.

title: Analyst/Senior Analyst, Tax Operations (12 Months Contract)
description:
About Maybank Securities

Maybank Securities, a leading brokerage and investment bank with a reach extending across ASEAN, the UK and the US, offers a comprehensive suite of services. These include corporate finance & advisory, navigating debt and equity capital markets, derivatives trading, brokerage and research for both retail and institutional investors, and prime brokerage.

We are seeking a motivated and detail‑oriented professional to support our tax operations across the Qualified Intermediary (QI), Qualified Derivatives Dealer (QDD), FATCA, and CRS frameworks. This role is well suited for an early‑career or developing tax operations specialist who is eager to build hands‑on experience in complex cross‑border tax compliance within a regulated financial services environment.

The Analyst will support day‑to‑day operational processes, regulatory reporting, and control framework execution, while working closely with senior team members, internal stakeholders, and external counterparties. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a strong foundation in tax concepts, an analytical mindset, and a willingness to learn and grow within a specialized tax operations function, contributing to the firm’s ongoing compliance and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Support

  • Support day‑to‑day tax operations across Qualified Intermediary (QI), Qualified Derivatives Dealer (QDD), FATCA, and CRS frameworks under guidance from senior team members.
  • Assist in the preparation and submission of U.S. tax filings, including IRS Forms 1042, 1042‑S, 1099, and FATCA/CRS returns to IRAS, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
  • Perform data validation and checks to support withholding tax calculations, treaty benefit application, and reporting accuracy.
  • Assist with U.S. withholding processes under Chapters 3 & 4, Section 871(m), and IRC §1446 for PTP distributions where applicable.
  • Support tax reconciliations with upstream custodians and internal records, including reconciliation of 1042‑S data and withholding amounts.
  • Help track payments, credits, and balances related to IRS 1042 filings and support follow‑up on discrepancies.

Documentation & Controls

  • Assist in the collection, validation, and maintenance of client tax documentation, including W‑8, W‑9, W‑8IMY, withholding statements, and CRS self‑certifications.
  • Perform completeness and reasonableness checks on tax forms and supporting documentation in accordance with QI, QDD, FATCA, and CRS requirements.
  • Support the maintenance of centralized tax documentation repositories to ensure audit readiness and regulatory compliance.
  • Participate in documentation refresh cycles and track document expiries to ensure timely renewals.
  • Assist in periodic internal checks and quality assurance reviews of documentation and reporting processes.

Certification & Compliance Support

  • Provide operational support for QI periodic reviews and Responsible Officer (RO) certification processes, including data gathering and evidence preparation.
  • Assist with responding to internal audits, regulatory queries, and information requests from tax authorities under supervision.
  • Support updates to operational procedures, checklists, and SOPs to reflect regulatory or process changes.

Stakeholder Collaboration & Learning

  • Work closely with senior tax team members, operations, compliance, and technology teams to support tax‑related processes.
  • Assist in responding to client, counterparty, or internal stakeholder queries related to tax documentation and reporting.
  • Keep abreast of basic developments in U.S. and international tax regulations (QI, QDD, FATCA, CRS) and escalate potential impacts to senior staff.
  • Participate in internal training sessions to develop technical knowledge and operational expertise.

Key Skills & Competencies / Preferred Attributes

  • 1–3 years of experience in tax operations, fund administration, custody operations, or financial services compliance (fresh graduates with strong interest will be considered).
  • Tertiary qualification in Accountancy, Finance, Banking, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Foundational understanding of U.S. withholding tax concepts, FATCA, and/or CRS (hands‑on experience is an advantage but not mandatory).
  • Familiarity with tax forms such as W‑8, W‑9, 1042, 1042‑S, or similar regulatory reporting is an advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail with an ability to follow processes and identify data inconsistencies.
  • Good analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
  • Willingness to learn complex tax frameworks and operate in a highly regulated environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams.
  • Proficient in spreadsheets and basic data analysis; exposure to tax or reporting systems is a plus.

title: STORE KEEPER
description:
Store Keeper Job Description

We are looking for an organized, experienced store keeper to be responsible for all stock, staff management, and planning promotional campaigns for the store. Storekeeper is a person who is responsible for goods in a store. Storekeeper is very important person for the store. He is the in charge of store department and also responsible for store control.

Storekeeper Duties & Responsibilities:

• Receive and forward all types of goods and deliveries in and out of the hotel to the correct point of storage area.

• Follow all standards for issuing and receiving stock within the store's area of operation.

• Monitor and take inventory on regular basis to compile orders based on par levels or needs.

• Assist the Accounts Payable Clerk / payable assistant in finding out any cost discrepancies.

• Complete requisition forms for inventory and supplies.

• Extend all requisitions on a daily basis and update the inventory management software/system.

• Work closely with Purchasing to order and receive items and equipment.

• Troubleshoot any vendor delivery issues and oversee/follow up on the return process.

• Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs.

• Perform any other duties as assigned by the management or supervisors.

• Bachelor’s degree in retail management, marketing, or related fields

• Positive, friendly, and organized

The Technical Program Management (TPM) team oversees end to end delivery of New Product Introduction (NPI) projects. The TPM assesses project complexity, allocates resources, and drives cross‑functional engineering alignment through structured checkpoints, weekly reviews, and close collaboration with Operations. They manage CAPEX, ensure functional milestones are met, and navigate a fast‑paced environment to deliver optimal, timely solutions. TPMs are proactive team players who steer coordination, make tough decisions, and support DF(X) and design‑to‑cost initiatives to achieve project goals.

  • Drive enterprise level cost saving initiatives spanning manufacturing, engineering, tooling, paint, and test functions.

  • Technical delivery milestones

  • End to end project planning

  • CAPEX management

  • DF(X) and cost-focused design reviews

  • Assess project complexity and develop department resource plans, securing approval and collaboration from all Engineering functions.

title: Cluster Coordinator iWork- Jimma
description:
Who we are

SOS Children’s Villages in Ethiopia is an International Non-governmental organization and a member of SOS Children’s Villages International Federation. We started our humanitarian work in Ethiopia with the opening of our first Village in Mekelle, Northern part of Ethiopia in 1974. Since then, we have expanded our programs to different regions where there are significant needs for intervention and where we believe we can work in partnership with all relevant actors to bring sustainable positive outcomes for children’s and young people.

Today, we have grown significantly to meet the persistent challenges that confront Ethiopian children who have lost parental care and those that are at risk of losing their parental care. Working in close collaboration with international donors, local government and community-based organizations across eight program locations; we aspire that every child grows up with love, respect and security.

Want to know more about life at SOS?

🌟 Explore our Employee Value Proposition Here

👉 Follow our journey on LinkedIn

Our Commitment to Safeguarding

At SOS Children's Villages, safeguarding isn't just a policy, it's a foundational value embedded in everything we do. We are unwavering in our commitment to protecting the children, young people, adults, and communities we serve, as well as our workforce and resources.

We cultivate an environment of trust and accountability where every voice is heard and respected. All successful candidates will be expected to champion our holistic safeguarding principles, actively upholding our Child & Youth Safeguarding Policy, Code of Conduct, and regulations against sexual misconduct, fraud, and corruption.

By joining our team, you commit to integrating these vital standards into your work, ensuring the highest levels of safety, ethics, and integrity in every action and partnership.

Together, we create a world where everyone feels safe, respected, and protected

Join Our Mission:

We are looking for a Proactive Cluster Coordinator to work under the supervision of the Location Program Director, being responsible for the overall coordination, planning, implementation, monitoring, quality assurance, and reporting of the iWork Programme within the assigned cluster. The role ensures effective delivery of interventions under the programme’s three pillars: Workforce Development, Host Institution Facilitation, and Ecosystem Strengthening.The position leads engagement with government institutions, private sector employers, TVET institutions, One-Stop Service Centers (OSS), and other ecosystem actors to facilitate quality internship opportunities for young women and disadvantaged groups as a pathway to employment and economic participation.The incumbent ensures that programme implementation complies with SOS Children's Villages policies and procedures, donor requirements, safeguarding standards, and national regulations. is responsible for the overall coordination, planning, implementation, monitoring, quality assurance, and reporting of the iWork Programme within the assigned cluster. The role ensures effective delivery of interventions under the programme’s three pillars: Workforce Development, Host Institution Facilitation, and Ecosystem Strengthening.

Key Responsibilities

Workforce Development

  • Coordinate the identification, mobilization, registration, screening, and onboarding of eligible young women and other vulnerable youth for programme participation.

  • Oversee participant profiling, career assessment, employability preparation, and life skills training to improve workforce readiness.

  • Monitor participant progress throughout the internship cycle and facilitate successful transition pathways into employment, entrepreneurship, or further learning opportunities.

  • Promote equitable participation and inclusion of women, persons with disabilities, refugees, internally displaced persons, and other marginalized groups across programme activities.

  • Verify participant attendance, internship completion records, and stipend documentation to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant stipend administration.

Host Institution Facilitation

  • Lead the identification, assessment, onboarding, and relationship management of host institutions across public, private, and civil society sectors.

  • Ensure host institutions comply with programme standards, safeguarding requirements, workplace ethics, accessibility, and inclusion policies.

  • Coordinate intern matching, placement, partnership agreements, internship contracts, and standard operating procedures to ensure quality internship experiences.

  • Monitor internship implementation through field visits, mentorship follow-up, performance reviews, and timely resolution of workplace challenges affecting interns and host organizations.

  • Conduct capacity assessments and coordinate technical training for host institutions on coaching, mentoring, safeguarding, gender equality, disability inclusion, workplace ethics, and conflict-sensitive business practices.

  • Provide ongoing technical assistance and follow-up support to strengthen host institutions' capacity to deliver inclusive, high-quality internship opportunities.

  • Conduct regular quality assurance visits, spot checks, and participant satisfaction assessments to maintain high standards of internship delivery and participant welfare.

Ecosystem Strengthening

  • Lead the planning, implementation, and periodic review of cluster-level programme activities in alignment with approved work plans, budgets, donor agreements, and organizational policies.

  • Develop annual operational plans, implementation schedules, and resource allocation plans to ensure effective programme delivery across the cluster.

  • Coordinate integrated implementation across programme pillars to achieve programme targets, milestones, and quality outcomes.

  • Facilitate regular planning, coordination, and performance review meetings with project teams and key stakeholders to strengthen programme effectiveness.

  • Identify programme implementation risks and implement appropriate mitigation measures to minimize operational disruptions.

  • Strengthen collaboration with OSS centres, TVET institutions, universities, community structures, and referral partners to expand participant outreach and engagement.

  • Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with government agencies, private sector employers, educational institutions, and development partners to strengthen internship ecosystems and labour market linkages.

  • Represent the programme in coordination forums, technical working groups, stakeholder engagement events, and policy dialogue initiatives related to youth employment and workforce development.

  • Ensure full compliance with safeguarding, gender equality, disability inclusion, and organizational protection standards across all programme activities and partnerships.

  • Monitor programme performance by ensuring accurate data collection, indicator tracking, documentation, reporting, and application of evidence for adaptive programme management.

  • Manage programme budgets, procurement processes, assets, and financial resources in accordance with donor requirements and organizational financial policies.

  • Review budget utilization, expenditure trends, forecasts, and financial reports to support effective resource management and accountability.

Our Ideal Candidate?

Let's find out if we're a match. The next step in our process depends on how your background closely align with the below criteria’s.

Essential Requirements (Must-Have):

Education:

Master’s degree in development studies, Economics, Business Administration, Project Management, Sociology, Social Work, Education, Labour Studies, or related fields.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 5 (Five) years of relevant professional experience in youth employment, workforce development, internship programmes, TVET, livelihoods, private sector engagement, or economic empowerment programmes.
  • Minimum of 3 (Three) years of the total relevant experience must be in project coordination or management roles.
  • Experience managing donor-funded programmes is required.

Role Specific Competencies:

  • Project Cycle Management (PCM): Ability to sequence activities logically, adjust plans in response to performance data, and reallocate resources effectively to stay on track.
  • Youth Employment and Workforce Development: Skill in applying labour market knowledge to assess intervention relevance and adjust approaches to improve actual placement outcomes.
  • Internship Programme Management: Capability to systematically monitor placement quality, resolve workplace issues impartially, and uphold participant welfare across all internship stages.
  • Partnership and Stakeholder Management: Ability to influence diverse actors, negotiate mutually beneficial arrangements, and maintain sustained engagement through consistent communication.
  • Labour Market Systems Development: Skill in analysing local employment ecosystems and facilitating durable connections between supply-side training and employer demand.
  • Monitoring, Evaluation, Accountability and Learning (MEAL): Capacity to critically interpret indicator data, translate findings into practical corrective actions, and promote team-wide use of evidence for decision-making.
  • Financial and Budget Management: Ability to track expenditure trends, identify variances early, and exercise sound judgment in resource reallocation to ensure donor compliance and value-for-money.
  • Safeguarding and Protection: Behavioural commitment to proactively identify risks, handle disclosures with confidentiality, and consistently model protective practices that influence others.
  • Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI): Skill in recognising and countering exclusionary biases, adapting outreach methods for marginalised groups, and holding partners accountable to equitable participation.
  • Private Sector Engagement: Capability to articulate clear business value propositions, negotiate credible placement agreements, and respond flexibly to shifting employer requirements.
  • Reporting and Documentation: Skill in synthesising complex programme data into concise, accurate, and well-structured narratives that meet donor expectations and internal review standards.

Desired Assets (Nice-to-Have):

  • Hands-on experience in donor engagement, public‑private partnerships, TVET systems, youth employment programming, policy advocacy.
  • Proficiency in local languages of the project implementing areas.

SOS Lead and Core Competencies

Lead Competency

  • Role model: Act as a role model for the organization, living our values and inspiring and learning from others
  • Collaboration: Remove barriers to participation, share decision making and build partnerships
  • Empowerment: Promote inclusion and equitable sharing of power
  • Strategic Thinking: Live the values and mission, setting realistic goals and translating them into actionable plans

Core Competency

  • Kindness: Act with empathy towards everyone he/she works with.
  • Continuous Learning: Make an effort to learn, understand and grow as a person, admitting your own mistakes.
  • Inclusiveness: In any actions show respect and care for others.
  • Initiative: speak up when things are not right, do not hesitate to act, and adapt to change when necessary.
  • Results Orientation: look for solutions and focus on desired results.

Does This Sound Like You?

title: Senior / Staff Computer Vision & AI Algorithm Engineer (Core R&D)
description:
Job Summary

We are hiring a core algorithm R&D engineer to develop and advance the key AI capabilities of our internally developed vision platform. You will drive research-to-production delivery of state-of-the-art computer vision, deep learning, and multimodal foundation model techniques, focusing on industrial-grade performance, robustness, and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Core Vision Algorithm R&D (Deep Learning + Transformers)

• Research, develop, and optimize computer vision algorithms across:

CNN-based classification, anomaly detection, Siamese networks, object detection, rotated object detection, semantic segmentation, instance segmentation, keypoint detection.

• Build and improve Transformer-based detection/recognition architectures and training pipelines.

• Design evaluation protocols, run ablation studies, and iterate based on measurable improvements (accuracy, robustness, latency).

Few-shot / Small-sample Learning for Industrial Use Cases

• Own R&D for few-shot rotated detection, segmentation, and anomaly detection—aiming to train effective models from only a few images.

• Explore and implement methods such as meta-learning, prompt-/prototype-based learning, retrieval-enhanced approaches, and foundation-model feature adaptation for industrial inspection scenarios.

LLM / VLM Fine-tuning & Reinforcement Learning (Post-training)

• Understand LLM/VLM principles and implement practical post-training pipelines:

• Supervised fine-tuning (SFT), parameter-efficient fine-tuning (e.g., LoRA/PEFT), alignment methods (e.g., RLHF/DPO-like approaches), evaluation harnesses and safety/quality checks.

• Build reproducible training workflows (data curation, experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment readiness).

Vector / Graph-based Learning for CAD/PCB & Structured Data

• Research and develop models beyond raster images for vector data scenarios (e.g., engineering drawings, PCB schematics/layouts), aiming to outperform image-based baselines.

• Apply graph neural networks (GNNs) and vector/geometric representations to tasks such as component understanding, connectivity reasoning, and structured recognition.

High-performance Implementation & Productionization

• Write efficient, maintainable code in C++ and Python for training/inference pipelines and algorithm modules.

• Develop high-performance compute kernels and optimizations using SIMD and/or CUDA, profiling and improving runtime, memory use, and throughput.

• Collaborate with platform/software teams to integrate algorithms into product modules and ensure test coverage, stability, and maintainability.

Paper Reading & Reproducibility

• Regularly read and analyze top-tier papers; identify key contributions and reproduce core algorithms in code.

• Deliver internal technical notes and share learnings with the team.

Required Qualifications

• Bachelor’s / Master’s / PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or related fields (industry experience may substitute).

• Strong fundamentals and hands-on experience in deep learning for computer vision, including detection and segmentation.

• Solid engineering ability with Python + C++; capable of building clean training code （with Pytorch) and production-ready modules.

• Practical experience with performance optimization and acceleration (one or more of CUDA / SIMD / parallel computing).

• Ability to communicate effectively in both Chinese (Mandarin) and English as the successful person will have to liaise with our counterparts in China
