title: Sr. Director AI-Driven Product Development
description:
Position Summary

Our organization is transforming how software gets built. We're moving beyond ad-hoc AI tool adoption and into a fully operationalized AI-Driven Development Lifecycle (AI-DLC), a continuous model that replaces the traditional SDLC. The AI Enablement Lead owns that transformation. This role governs how AI is adopted and used: practice, tooling, training, and value tracking. This role reports to the CTO and will work closely with the Software Development Leadership.

Objectives

  • Own AI initiative intake and prioritization. Build a repeatable process for triaging every pilot or build request against business value, data readiness, and team capacity.
  • Standardize tooling and practice. Evaluate and select agentic coding tools within the architecture the Software Technical Lead defines. Build internal playbooks covering when and how to use agents, prompting and context patterns, and review standards for AI-generated code. Prevent fragmented, team-by-team tool sprawl.
  • Run a Product Operating Model (preferred method) transformation through pilot teams. Frame initiative intake and prioritization around a small number of pilot teams pursuing strategy, discovery, and delivery changes together.
  • Extend tooling standards to product discovery, not just engineering. Product managers and designers using AI for rapid prototyping, synthesizing customer insight, and testing feasibility assumptions is in scope for the same playbooks currently written for engineers.
  • Defines data availability requirements. Coordinates with Hardware/Firmware leads on data availability requirements for strategic roadmap of AI capabilities; not to build firmware, but to make sure the product data contract is co-designed rather than software discovering the gap after the fact.
  • Scout and promote reuse. Actively look for overlapping AI solutions and patterns across teams. Treat duplication as a standing risk to manage, not an occasional cleanup exercise.
  • Build and run a champion network. Recruit and coordinate AI champions embedded in each team to drive peer-led adoption, including training curriculum, and track completion and competency skills for engineering and product roles.
  • Define and report value-realization metrics. Track cycle time, PR throughput, defect rate, developer satisfaction, and cost/efficiency impact. Report results to the CTO framed as business value, not adoption counts.
  • Track governance capacity as a metric. Monitor review- and security-gate throughput. Under AI-DLC, this is the bottleneck that replaces code-writing speed, and it needs to be measured like one.
  • Partner across the organization. Align adoption pacing with the Director of Software Development's sprint capacity and delivery commitments. Collaborate with the EAD team and Operations team on tools and best practices of AI adoption and program acceleration. Coordinate with security and governance owners on data handling, code review, and the automated scanning and approval gates AI-DLC's Construction and Operations phases require.

Requirements

Education/Experience:

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.
  • 8-12 years in software delivery, digital enablement, or technical program management.

Skills:

  • Strong understanding of software delivery workflows: design, development, QA, review, and release
  • Experience managing pipelines, portfolios, pilots, or proof-of-concepts, including capturing value, ROI, and lessons learned
  • Preferred but not required to have a working knowledge of the Product Operating Model: outcome-based roadmaps, empowered product teams, facilitating workshops and ideation sessions with real follow-through on decisions
  • Experience partnering with product management and design, not only engineering, on adoption of new practice
  • Experience setting and managing budgets or staffing plans at a program level
  • Excellent oral, visual, and written communication with both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional work and influence stakeholders without formal authority over them
  • Technical depth to hold a credible feasibility conversation with technical architecture owners
  • Understands how AI-powered tools and systems work well enough to evaluate vendor proposals and ask the right technical questions.
  • Proven experience in AI, digital enablement, or analytics environments
  • Familiarity with change management and communications planning applied to technology adoption

description:
Job Summary

The BIM Modeller is responsible for developing, maintaining, and coordinating accurate Building Information Models (BIM) for construction and engineering projects. The role involves producing detailed 3D models and drawings based on design information, ensuring compliance with project requirements, BIM standards, and relevant industry practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate models between different disciplines and identify clashes or discrepancies.
  • Conduct clash detection and assist the BIM Coordinator/Manager in resolving coordination issues.
  • Update BIM models based on design revisions, site conditions, and construction requirements.
  • Ensure models and drawings comply with project BIM standards, specifications, and company procedures.
  • Prepare drawings and documentation required for construction and submission purposes.
  • Assist in producing BIM deliverables, including plans, sections, elevations, details, schedules, and quantity information.

  • Maintain proper version control and ensure BIM files and related documentation are properly managed.
  • Participate in BIM coordination meetings and provide technical input when required.
  • Assist with as-built modelling and updating models based on actual site conditions.
  • Perform other BIM-related duties as assigned by the BIM Manager or Project Manager.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Architecture, M&E Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 2 years of relevant experience as a BIM Modeller or in a similar role.
  • Proficient in Autodesk Revit and/or other relevant BIM software.
  • Experience with AutoCAD, Navisworks, and BIM 360/ACC will be an advantage.
  • Knowledge of BIM modelling, coordination, and clash detection processes.
  • Able to read and interpret architectural, structural, and M&E drawings.
  • Good understanding of construction methods and technical drawings.
  • Good communication and coordination skills.
  • Detail-oriented with good problem-solving abilities.
  • Able to work independently as well as collaboratively with project teams.

title: Senior/Staff SLM & VLM Engineer — Post-Training, Tool Calling & Agents
description:
Job Summary

We are looking for a highly capable engineer/researcher to lead the R&D of Small Language Models (SLMs) and Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for edge / low-latency and cost-efficient production scenarios. You will own the continuous pretraining, supervised instruction tuning (SFT), and compression/distillation pipelines, and work closely with platform teams to deliver reliable, measurable improvements in inference efficiency, tool-use success rate, and overall model quality.

Key Responsibilities

1) SLM/VLM Training: Continuous Pretraining & Instruction Tuning (SFT)

• Conduct continuous pretraining and SFT for SLMs and VLMs to improve task performance and domain adaptation.

• Build reproducible training workflows in PyTorch, including data processing, training, evaluation, and model versioning.

2) Compression, Distillation & Edge/Low-Latency Inference Optimization

• Design and implement efficient compression strategies for SLM/VLM, including knowledge distillation, pruning, and quantization-oriented training or post-training optimization.

• Optimize model serving and inference for low-latency / edge scenarios by improving throughput and cost-per-token via techniques such as quantization, caching/KV optimizations, batching strategies, and decoding-time optimizations.

3) Tool Calling System: Catalog, Routing, Validation, Fallback & Observability

• Architect and implement a production-grade tool calling (function/tool calling) framework:

• Tool cataloging and metadata/schema design

• Tool selection/routing and argument construction

• Parameter validation, result verification, and safe fallback/retry strategies

• Call-chain tracing, monitoring, and observability to improve success rate and ROI

4) RL & Reward Modeling for Alignment and Tool-Use Reliability

• Apply post-training methods such as PPO / DPO / GRPO-like optimization and reward modeling to align the model toward objectives including:

• semantic understanding

• tool-use success rate

• content generation quality and consistency

• Support both offline and online iteration loops, including policy evaluation, regression checks, and safe deployment gating.

5) Data Pipeline Automation (Collection, Cleaning, Curation)

• Design automated pipelines for data collection, filtering, cleaning, de-duplication, labeling/weak supervision, and dataset version management to continuously improve training quality.

• Ensure datasets support both SFT and preference/RL style post-training.

6) Rigorous Evaluation, Testing & Iteration

• Build robust evaluation mechanisms: offline benchmarks, task suites for tool-use, regression tests, and reliability metrics.

• Drive rapid iteration through A/B comparisons, ablations, and failure analysis, improving both quality and efficiency over time.

Required Qualifications

• Strong software engineering skills in Python and C++, including experience building ML training/evaluation pipelines in PyTorch.

• Hands-on experience in model efficiency and inference optimization (e.g., distillation, quantization, pruning, serving optimization).

• Experience with high-performance computing and acceleration: CUDA and/or SIMD, profiling and performance tuning.

• Ability to read and reproduce key ideas from recent papers and implement algorithms with strong experimental discipline.

• Ability to communicate effectively in both Chinese (Mandarin) and English as the successful person will have to liaise with counterparts in China.

electronics, or related technical services.

title: Quality Control Technician
description:
Job Responsibilities: Inspection & Quality Control

Inspection & Quality Control

  • Incoming, In-Process & Outgoing Checks: Perform quality inspections at all stages of production, including incoming materials, in-process assemblies, and finished products, to ensure compliance with specifications.
  • Product Audits: Carry out scheduled product audits to verify adherence to established standards.
  • Interpret Engineering Drawings: Review and understand technical drawings to extract dimensions, tolerances, and specifications required for inspection and assembly.
  • Perform Dimensional Inspections: Use precision measuring tools (e.g., callipers, micrometres, gauges) to verify that physical dimensions meet specified tolerances.

  • Assist in Quality Initiatives: Support quality improvement projects and process enhancements.
  • Support Production: Assist with camera assembly or network setup when additional resources are required on the production line.

Documentation & Record-Keeping

  • Maintain Records: Keep inspection logs updated using MS Office tools (Excel, Word) or equivalent software, ensuring accuracy and completeness of quality-related documentation.

Job Requirements

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify non-conformities.
  • Familiarity with GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing) is required
  • Able to work independently with minimal supervision while handling multiple tasks and ad-hoc requests.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate across teams.
  • Basic computer literacy, with hands-on experience in MS Office and data entry.
  • 1-2 years relevant experience in Inspection & Quality Control

description:
Savio House:

Position: Family Wellness Therapist

Join Savio in our mission to keep families together! We are actively seeking a bilingual clinician dedicated to making a difference in our community by providing therapeutic services to those who need them most. This role is an extraordinary opportunity for someone genuinely passionate about supporting the spanish-speaking community. Through a vibrant collaboration between Savio and a local grassroots community program, you will bridge two vital systems of care. Together, let's transform the lives of children, youth, and families while gaining invaluable experience in evidence-based therapeutic interventions. Step forward and be part of something meaningful!


Focus: Utilizing family preservation techniques and trauma-informed treatments(TF-CBT and TST), we work together to keep children and youth with their families when a child safety concern has been identified.

This position serves the Denver area.


Salary:

Starting with candidacy (LPCC, SWC, MFTC): $58,660

Starting Licensed (LCSW, LPC, LMFT): $61,660

Starting MA Bilingual: $63,660-$66,660

** Supervision towards professional licenses provided in this role


About Savio:

Founded over 50 years ago, Savio has been centered around driving change and healing through evidence based therapeutic treatment to children, adolescents, and their families. We believe that by stepping into a child’s every-day life, a therapist can understand the root causes of a family’s dysfunction and prescribe the right treatment. We drop barriers to access by providing services to families in their homes, and have teams in Denver and the surrounding areas, Colorado Springs, and in more rural cities all across the state.

Joining one of Savio’s teams, you would be a change maker in your community, and help family after family stay together.


Daily Impact of a Family Wellness Therapist looks like:

  • Supporting caregivers in creating an environment that promotes safety and stability for their children (0-18 years of age)
  • Engaging primary caregivers in active, change-orientated treatment by identifying and overcoming barriers to progress and connecting them with services and supports.

title: Accounts & Tenant Payment Executive
description:
1. Tenant Payment Data Entry and Recording

The primary responsibility of the staff is to ensure that all tenant payments received are accurately and promptly recorded in EWG2's billing/accounting system.

Responsibilities include:

  • Capture and record all tenant payments received.
  • Update tenant accounts with the correct:
  • Tenant name/account
  • Payment date
  • Payment amount
  • Payment reference
  • Bank/payment method
  • Relevant invoice or outstanding balance.
  • Ensure payments are allocated to the correct tenant account and invoice.
  • Identify and flag payments where the tenant or invoice cannot be determined.
  • Check for duplicate or unusual payment entries.
  • Ensure all payment records are updated promptly and accurately.
  • Maintain proper records of payment transactions for future reference.

2. Bank Statement and Payment Reconciliation

The staff will assist in ensuring that tenant payment records are consistent with actual bank receipts.

Responsibilities include:

  • Obtain bank statements or payment reports from the relevant landlord / Managing Agent (MA), where required.
  • Liaise with the landlord / MA finance team to obtain:
  • Bank statements
  • Bank transaction listings
  • Payment reports
  • Payment references or remittance information.
  • Match bank receipts against tenant payment records.
  • Identify unidentified or unmatched payments.
  • Prepare a list of unmatched receipts for follow-up.
  • Highlight discrepancies to the Finance Manager or relevant colleague.
  • Maintain supporting documentation for payment reconciliation.

Important: The staff should be responsible for reconciliation and identification of discrepancies, but final financial review or approval should remain with the Finance Manager where applicable.

3. Tenant Account Maintenance

Maintain accurate tenant account information within EWG2's billing system.

Responsibilities include:

  • Update tenant payment records.
  • Assist in maintaining tenant account information.
  • Ensure changes to tenant account information are properly documented.
  • Assist in updating account status following payment.
  • Check that payment allocations are correctly reflected in the tenant's account.
  • Assist in resolving discrepancies between tenant records and payment information.

4. Support for Arrears Management

The staff will provide accurate and timely information to the colleague responsible for arrears management.

Responsibilities include:

  • Ensure all received payments are posted before arrears reports are generated.
  • Provide updated payment information to the arrears-management team.
  • Identify tenants who have made partial payments.
  • Identify payments that have not been allocated to tenant accounts.
  • Provide payment history when required for collection follow-up.
  • Assist in resolving payment-related queries raised by the arrears-management team.
  • Ensure that payments received after arrears follow-up are promptly updated.

Note: The staff should not be primarily responsible for debt collection. Their role is to ensure the arrears-management colleague has accurate and up-to-date payment information.

5. Payment Reports and Reconciliation Reports

Prepare routine reports required for the Tenant Management Services operation.

Responsibilities include:

  • Prepare daily or periodic tenant payment reports.
  • Prepare bank receipt reconciliation reports.
  • Prepare unidentified payment reports.
  • Prepare outstanding/unallocated receipt reports.
  • Provide payment summaries to the relevant EWG2 team member.
  • Assist in generating reports from the billing system.
  • Highlight unusual or inconsistent transactions.

6. Liaison with Landlord / Managing Agent

As part of the Tenant Management Services function, the staff may be required to communicate directly with the landlord or MA's finance team.

Responsibilities include:

  • Request bank statements and payment information.
  • Clarify payment references and unidentified receipts.
  • Follow up on missing payment information.
  • Verify payment dates and amounts.
  • Resolve discrepancies between bank records and EWG2's records.
  • Maintain proper records of correspondence and information received.

Note: This should be positioned as operational liaison, rather than financial decision-making or financial management.

7. General Accounts Support

The staff may provide basic accounts support where required.

Responsibilities include:

  • Assist with basic bookkeeping and data entry.
  • Assist in maintaining accounting records.
  • Assist in filing financial documents.
  • Assist with reconciliation of tenant-related transactions.
  • Assist in preparing supporting schedules requested by the Finance Manager.
  • Perform other routine finance-related administrative duties assigned by the Finance Manager.

8. Data Accuracy and Confidentiality

Given that the staff will handle a substantial volume of tenant payment information, accuracy and confidentiality should be an important part of the role.

Responsibilities include:

  • Maintain a high level of accuracy in payment data entry.
  • Perform basic checks before finalising payment entries.
  • Maintain confidentiality of tenant and financial information.
  • Follow EWG2's data protection and information-security procedures.
  • Ensure financial records are properly maintained and protected.
  • Immediately report suspected errors, duplicate payments or unusual transactions.

description:
About Akkodis

Akkodis is a global leader in the engineering and R&D market, leveraging the power of connected data to accelerate innovation and digital transformation. With more than 50,000 engineers and digital experts across 30 countries, Akkodis delivers deep cross-sector expertise across North America, EMEA and APAC.

As part of The Adecco Group, Akkodis brings together the strengths of AKKA and Modis, combining broad industry expertise with capabilities across key technology domains including mobility, software and technology services, robotics, testing, simulation, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence and data analytics.

About the Role

Program:

Robotics & Automation Deployment

Travel:

Occasional travel to pilot and deployment sites

Akkodis is supporting an innovative robotics and automation initiative focused on deploying autonomous, AI-assisted robotic systems into industrial and rail maintenance environments.

As a Robotics Deployment & Simulation Engineer, you will be the technical owner on the ground, helping translate operational requirements into successful robotic deployments. You will work across operations, engineering, quality, HSE, IT, data/AI teams and technology suppliers to take projects from scope definition and simulation through commissioning, testing, operation and value demonstration.

The role combines field engineering, robotics deployment, 3D simulation and digital twins, system integration and stakeholder coordination.

Required Profile

We are looking for an engineer with a strong combination of robotics deployment, engineering simulation, industrial operations and project coordination experience, ideally with exposure to rail, mobility or other mission-critical environments.

  • Degree in General Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  • Hands-on experience supporting the deployment of autonomous robotic systems, robotic inspection solutions or industrial automation from Proof of Concept (POC) through to operational deployment.

  • Experience analysing maintenance plans, operational procedures and inspection activities to identify and scope tasks suitable for robotic automation.

  • Strong value analysis / business case mindset, with the ability to assess automation opportunities and quantify operational benefits.

  • Experience developing and executing robot test strategies, including defining test scenarios, inspection sequences and performance validation.

  • Practical experience with robotics simulation and modelling to validate robot behaviour, inspection sequences, trajectories and operational scenarios before physical deployment.

  • Strong 3D modelling and digital engineering capabilities, with hands-on experience using tools such as CATIA V5, AutoCAD, Revit, Twinmotion or equivalent 3D/CAD/simulation platforms.

  • Exposure to digital twins, virtual environments, 3D visualisation or simulation-based validation is highly desirable.

  • Experience working across operations, engineering, quality and industrial teams, coordinating multiple stakeholders to deliver technology deployments.

  • Ability to translate technical and operational requirements into clear specifications, test plans and implementation activities.

  • Experience supporting solution testing, acceptance validation and technical requirement verification.

  • Familiarity with industrial maintenance, inspection processes, rail/mobility environments or other operationally complex settings.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and proactively identify deployment risks and practical solutions.

  • Comfortable working between field operations, engineering teams, technology suppliers and project/program management.

  • Willingness to travel to pilot and deployment sites and work in operational environments where safety, site access and operational constraints are critical.

Technical Skills

Autonomous Robotics & Inspection: Experience with autonomous visual inspection robotics and supporting deployment from POC through operational implementation.

Robotics Testing & Simulation: Experience developing robot test strategies and using simulation to validate robot behaviour and inspection sequences.

Maintenance & Automation Analysis: Strong exposure to analysing maintenance plans, identifying inspection tasks suitable for automation and conducting value analysis.

3D Modelling & Engineering: Hands-on experience with CATIA V5, AutoCAD, Revit and Twinmotion, including BIM and structural modelling.

Technical & Cross-functional Coordination: Experience translating technical requirements into specifications, consolidating information across teams and supporting solution testing.

Ideal Background

The ideal candidate will have experience similar to an Innovation / Robotics Deployment Engineer who has already worked on taking an emerging technology from POC → testing → simulation → field deployment → operational adoption.

Experience in rail, autonomous inspection, mobility, industrial maintenance, robotics or other mission-critical operational environments will be highly valued.

Apply Now

Don't miss this opportunity to be part of a dynamic and growing team. Take the next step in your career journey with Akkodis.

  • Current salary
  • Expected salary

title: DevOps Manager
description:
DevOps Engineer

Company: Invigilo AI
Location: Singapore / Hybrid or Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

About Invigilo AI

Invigilo AI builds AI-powered safety and operations technology for high-risk industrial environments including construction, manufacturing, logistics, oil and gas, mining and maritime.

Our platform turns existing CCTV and camera infrastructure into an intelligent safety layer, using computer vision and AI to identify risks such as unsafe behaviour, PPE violations, equipment interactions, restricted-area entry, falls, fire and smoke, and other operational events in real time.

Our systems operate across a mix of on-premise edge servers, cloud infrastructure and hybrid deployments, often in challenging industrial environments where reliability matters.

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to help us build, deploy and operate the infrastructure that powers these systems globally.

What You'll Do

You will work closely with our AI, backend and deployment teams to ensure Invigilo's platform can be reliably deployed and operated across customer environments.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for our backend, AI and edge applications.

  • Containerize and deploy applications using Docker and related orchestration technologies.

  • Manage cloud infrastructure, primarily across platforms such as Azure and AWS.

  • Support deployment of Invigilo's AI stack on customer on-premise GPU servers.

  • Automate provisioning, configuration and deployment of new servers and environments.

  • Manage Linux-based infrastructure and troubleshoot production systems.

  • Build monitoring, logging and alerting systems for application, server, GPU and infrastructure health.

  • Monitor uptime and performance across distributed customer deployments.

  • Manage networking requirements including VPNs, firewalls, ports, RTSP streams and secure connectivity between customer sites and Invigilo systems.

  • Support GPU infrastructure used for computer vision and AI inference workloads.

  • Improve deployment reliability, rollback processes and disaster recovery procedures.

  • Maintain infrastructure-as-code and configuration management practices.

  • Work with engineering teams to improve application observability and production readiness.

  • Implement security best practices around access control, secrets, encryption, patching and infrastructure hardening.

  • Help troubleshoot deployments together with field engineers and customers when required.

  • Continuously improve the way we deploy and manage hundreds of cameras, AI services and edge devices across multiple sites.

What We're Looking For

You should have strong practical experience running production systems rather than only theoretical DevOps knowledge.

Ideally, you have experience with several of the following:

  • Linux administration

  • Docker and containerized applications

  • CI/CD using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins or similar

  • Azure, AWS or another major cloud platform

  • Terraform, Ansible or similar infrastructure automation tools

  • Kubernetes or container orchestration

  • Nginx and reverse proxies

  • Networking, VPNs, DNS, firewalls and TCP/IP

  • Monitoring tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Loki or similar

  • PostgreSQL, Redis or other production databases

  • Bash and/or Python scripting

  • Git and modern software development workflows

Experience working with GPU servers, NVIDIA drivers, CUDA, computer vision systems, video streaming or RTSP infrastructure would be particularly valuable.

Bonus Points

Experience in any of the following would be a strong advantage:

  • NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA and GPU monitoring

  • Edge AI or computer vision deployments

  • CCTV, IP cameras, NVRs and RTSP streaming

  • NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer or FFmpeg

  • Large-scale distributed edge deployments

  • Azure IoT or edge computing platforms

  • High-availability infrastructure

  • Cybersecurity and infrastructure hardening

  • ISO 27001 environments

  • Deploying systems into enterprise or industrial customer networks

What Success Looks Like

Within the role, you will help us reach a point where:

  • A new customer deployment can be provisioned rapidly and consistently.

  • Software updates can be safely deployed across distributed sites with minimal manual intervention.

  • Infrastructure failures are detected before customers report them.

  • GPU, camera and application health can be monitored centrally.

  • Engineering teams can confidently release new versions without worrying about deployment complexity.

  • Our infrastructure scales from tens of deployments to hundreds and eventually thousands of sites.

Who You'll Work With

You will work directly with our:

  • AI and Computer Vision Engineers

  • Backend Engineers

  • Product Team

  • Project and Deployment Teams

  • Customer Success Team

Because our technology operates in real industrial environments, you will also occasionally work through unusual infrastructure challenges that you would rarely encounter in a conventional SaaS company, from isolated customer networks and unreliable connectivity to on-premise GPU servers processing dozens of live video streams.

Why Invigilo

At Invigilo, DevOps is not simply about keeping a web application online.

The infrastructure you build supports AI systems monitoring real construction sites, factories, logistics facilities and other high-risk workplaces. Reliability directly affects whether our platform can identify safety risks when they matter.

You'll have significant ownership over how Invigilo's infrastructure evolves as we scale internationally and expand our AI platform.

title: Locum Palm Beach Surgeon
description:
Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine (PRM) is a national healthcare organization whose core business is providing evidence-based, individualized treatment services for pelvic pain and Endometriosis patients. There is a Women’s Health component to the position as pelvic pain affects 25% of women of reproductive age. In the US chronic pelvic pain affects 28 million women and is projected to grow to 43.6 million by 2050 according to the NICHD. Most of our female patients suffer from underlying Gynecological issues, Endometriosis being the most prevalent as it is a chronic disease that affects one in nine women and presents with pelvic pain and infertility.


Persistent pelvic pain is often overlooked, untreated, and misguided. At PRM, our mission is to decrease the time patients are suffering from pelvic pain symptoms. Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine has positioned itself at the center of the pelvic pain ecosystem. We are nationally recognized experts dedicated to reducing the number of people suffering from this affliction. Our unique in-office, ultrasound-guided approach to the pelvis is the first of its kind in the country. Our team focuses on diagnosing and treating chronic pelvic pain in women and men with a procedure that is safe, effective, and more comfortable than what has been offered by pelvic pain providers in the past.


Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine was formed in 2017 and is headquartered in West Palm Beach, FL. Since its inception, PRM has experienced rapid growth and routinely attracts patients from across the US and internationally. Pelvic Rehabilitation Medicine's fast-paced success has garnered the investment community's attention, positioning it to expand into new markets.

Locations: Denver/Denver Metro Area, Northern Colorado, Colorado Springs and surrounding areas, Eastern Plains of Colorado, Western Slope of Colorado.

-The MST treatment model is an ecological therapeutic intervention for youth aged 12-17 who exhibit high risk behaviors, including substance use, runaway, and truancy.

To learn more about MST, check out the website: MST Services | Multisystemic Therapy for Juveniles

- Focused on improving child safety and/or helping children heal from the impact of trauma.

To learn more about the models, check out the websites: TF-CBT Certification Program - Official Website (tfcbt.org)

- Help caregivers understand typical developmental challenges and expectations;

- Supporting caregivers’ problem solving

title: Corp Dir of Memory Care & Resident Experience
description:
Reports To: Chief Clinical Operations Officer

Assigned Region: Region 1 (MA / CT / NY) or Region 2 (OH / NJ / DC)

Summary: The Corporate Director of Memory Care & Experience / Lifestyle provides strategic leadership and operational support for both Memory Care and Experience & Lifestyle programs across an assigned region of Maplewood and Inspīr communities. Two Corporate Directors share portfolio-wide coverage — one for Region 1 (MA / CT / NY) and one for Region 2 (OH / NJ / DC). Within the assigned region, each Director is accountable for consistent execution of person-centered dementia care and vibrant, trend-forward resident engagement, aligned with the MSL Truly Living model and each brand’s standards of excellence. Beyond the assigned region, each Director serves as the enterprise subject-matter expert (SME) in a designated area of specialty — Memory Care or Experience & Lifestyle — ensuring the organization retains depth of expertise across the portfolio.

• Regional operational ownership — The Director owns day-to-day performance and outcomes for both Memory Care and Experience & Lifestyle within the assigned region, providing close, consistent support to community-based directors and coordinators through regular field presence.

• Enterprise subject-matter expertise — The Director serves as the company-wide lead and internal expert in the designated domain of specialty, available to both regions for guidance, program design, training, and clinical or experiential differentiation.

Accountability and Cross-Regional Authority

The regional Director holds primary accountability for all outcomes within the assigned region. The enterprise SME holds approval authority, in both regions, over the items listed below. This structure preserves single-point regional accountability while protecting enterprise consistency in each specialty.

The following require enterprise SME review and approval in both regions:

  • Regulatory survey responses and plans of correction in the SME’s domain
  • Launch or material revision of any enterprise-wide program in the SME’s domain
  • Dementia-care training curriculum and CDP-qualifying seminar content
  • Elopement drill methodology and quarterly drill review findings
  • Adoption of new engagement technology or digital platforms at enterprise scale
  • All other matters — including routine community operations, field visits, coaching, and lifestyle calendar oversight — are owned by the regional Director without SME review.
  • Where the regional Director and the enterprise SME cannot align on a cross-regional matter, the decision escalates to the Chief Clinical Operations Officer.

Essential Functions:

Regional Operational Leadership & Brand Standardization

  • Own daily operations of both Memory Care and Experience & Lifestyle departments across all communities in the assigned region, ensuring adherence to each brand's standards of excellence.
  • Provide direct support and guidance to community Memory Care Directors and Experience/Lifestyle Directors to foster a consistent, high-quality resident experience.
  • Implement and refine scalable operational best practices that promote consistency across the region while allowing personalization to meet local and individual resident needs.
  • Conduct regular field visits, audits, and operational reviews across the region to evaluate performance, reinforce brand standards, and provide hands-on support.
  • Lead regular strategic check-ins with community directors to address opportunities, trends, and challenges.
  • Lead with strong time management, prioritization, and accountability across locations to maximize productivity and resident engagement.
  • Foster a positive, inclusive environment rooted in compassion, creativity, and purpose — driving a culture of wellness, joy, teamwork, and innovation.

Memory Care Oversight

  • Ensure consistent execution of memory care philosophy, standards, and clinical practices aligned with the MSL Truly Living model.
  • Champion compassionate, person-centered dementia care and interdisciplinary care strategies for residents with cognitive impairments.
  • Partner with clinical leadership to design and evaluate dementia-specific programs that improve cognitive, behavioral, and safety outcomes.
  • Monitor clinical indicators such as behaviors, falls, and elopement events to inform risk mitigation and care improvements.
  • Support development and oversight of dementia-specific care pathways and documentation standards.

Experience & Lifestyle Programming

  • Provide strategic leadership and oversight of Experience, Lifestyle, and resident engagement operations, maintaining a best-in-class brand identity and excellence in service delivery.
  • Co-create and implement resident-centric programs that support physical, emotional, intellectual, and spiritual well-being.
  • Oversee lifestyle calendars and memory care engagement models to ensure vibrancy, variety, dignity, and inclusiveness.
  • Champion personalization and engagement — ensuring every experience is meaningful and reflective of resident preferences.
  • Promote innovative partnerships, entertainment, enrichment, and wellness opportunities that enhance the overall resident journey.

Innovation, Trends & Technology

  • Stay current on emerging trends, research, and best practices in dementia care, senior living, and wellness through conferences, education, and partnerships.
  • Evaluate and adopt new technologies and digital engagement platforms that enhance resident connection, engagement, quality of life, and outcomes.
  • Encourage experimentation, ideation, and continuous improvement across memory care and Experience & Lifestyle programs.

Enterprise Subject-Matter Expertise

  • Serve as the organization’s internal expert and enterprise-wide lead in the designated area of specialty, available to both regions.
  • Provide cross-regional consultation, program design, and thought leadership so the company retains depth of expertise as operational responsibility becomes regionally structured.
  • Exercise approval authority over the cross-regional items defined under Accountability and Cross-Regional Authority above.
  • Collaborate with Marketing and Brand Development to articulate the company’s dementia care philosophy, training standards, and clinical and experiential differentiation.

Partnerships & Collaboration

Build and maintain strong relationships with residents, families, staff, vendors, and community partners to gather insights and strengthen engagement.

Maintain a standing partnership with Brand Development and Marketing, including monthly alignment on experience programming, brand standards, and market-facing differentiation. Secure Brand Development input prior to launch of any enterprise-wide experience or lifestyle program.

Collaborate cross-functionally with home-office departments — including marketing, culinary, HR, and Care — to ensure program alignment with brand strategy.

Cultivate strategic partnerships with external organizations such as Alzheimer's associations, hospitals, and universities to support programming and referral relationships.

Family & Community Engagement

  • Participate, as needed, in family meetings, educational seminars, and transition planning discussions.
  • Serve as a visible resource to families navigating cognitive decline, care level changes, and move-in transitions.

Training, Development & Leadership Coaching

  • Develop and lead onboarding and continuing-education programs for community Memory Care and Experience/Lifestyle Directors and coordinators.
  • Identify developmental needs and implement educational programs that enhance staff competencies and leadership growth.
  • Facilitate dementia education, hands-on coaching, mentorship, and leadership training.
  • Conduct “Alzheimer’s Disease and Dementia Care” seminars to support Certified Dementia Practitioner (CDP) designations. (Requires trainer-level credential — see Qualifications.)
  • Implement succession planning and talent-development strategies for future leadership.

Quality Assurance, Compliance & Survey Readiness

  • Monitor program outcomes and resident satisfaction data to identify trends, successes, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Leverage feedback and analytics to drive decisions, inspire innovation, and elevate the resident experience.
  • Oversee QA initiatives including CQE / Trip Reports, monthly audits, elopement drill reviews, and outcomes analysis.
  • Ensure documentation, care practices, and staffing models comply with all federal, state, and local regulations.
  • Lead communities in survey readiness and respond to identified deficiencies with corrective action plans.

Behavioral Support & Crisis Intervention

  • Provide training and coaching to community leaders on managing behaviors related to dementia.
  • Guide community directors in crisis management, de-escalation techniques, and personalized care approaches for residents with challenging needs.

Strategic Planning

  • Partner with executive and clinical leadership to shape long-term strategic goals for memory care and Experience & Lifestyle initiatives that align with organizational objectives.
  • Maintain current knowledge of industry developments and legislative changes that may impact program delivery or resident outcomes.
  • Performance in this role is evaluated against the following measures within the assigned region, and enterprise-wide within the designated specialty:
  • Regulatory survey outcomes — deficiency rate and repeat-citation rate in memory care and resident engagement domains
  • Elopement drill completion and corrective-action closure rates
  • CDP certification rate across community Memory Care leadership
  • Resident and family satisfaction scores by domain
  • Memory care occupancy and length of stay
  • On-time delivery of assigned program development and launch milestones

Education/Experience/Licensure/Certification

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree in healthcare administration, gerontology, hospitality, or a related field preferred.

• Certified Dementia Practitioner (CDP) or equivalent required or obtained within 90 days of placement in the role.

• Trainer-level dementia credential (NCCDP CADDCT or equivalent) required to conduct CDP-qualifying seminars, or obtained within 180 days of placement in the role.

  • 7+ years of progressive leadership experience in senior living, healthcare, wellness, or hospitality, with demonstrated expertise in dementia/memory care and/or lifestyle/resident engagement programming.
  • Proven success leading large teams across multiple locations, with strong project-management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Demonstrated track record developing and implementing effective programs and services in a senior living setting.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, capable of effectively engaging staff, residents, and family members.
  • Creative, visionary, and results-driven, with a sincere passion for serving the senior population.
  • Technologically proficient, able to evaluate and implement digital engagement platforms and operational tools.

Travel Requirements

Regular travel within the assigned region to ensure consistency and quality across communities, estimated at 50–60% of working time. title: R&D Engineer (Biomedical Engineering / Medical Devices)
description:
About the Role

JN Medsys is a Singapore-based medtech company specialising in digital PCR (dPCR) technologies and molecular diagnostics.

We are looking for a hands-on and versatile R&D Engineer to support the development of our next generation of digital PCR instruments and products. The role combines product development, laboratory work and technical operations, and is suitable for someone who enjoys working across different areas in a small technology company.

Training in digital PCR and our technologies will be provided.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development, prototyping and testing of digital PCR instruments and related products, including assembly, modification and evaluation of prototype systems.
  • Prepare and modify 3D CAD models, engineering drawings and simple mechanical designs, and coordinate with suppliers and fabrication vendors to produce prototype components.
  • Perform digital PCR experiments, product testing and QC, including preparation of samples, operation of instruments, analysis of results and maintenance of experimental records.
  • Assist with customer and distributor technical support, including responding to technical enquiries, preparing product demonstrations, troubleshooting and providing application support.
  • Coordinate with suppliers, contractors and external engineering partners on components, fabrication, purchasing and product development activities.
  • Support R&D projects and grant activities, including preparation of technical documentation, test reports, project updates and supporting information for grant applications.
  • Assist with routine technical and business operations, including purchasing, inventory, logistics, quotations and coordination with external service providers.
  • Maintain appropriate technical documentation, including engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), experimental records, QC data and product documentation.
  • Participate in other R&D and product development activities as the company's technologies and projects progress.

Requirements

  • Diploma or Degree in Biomedical Engineering, Bioengineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
  • Competency in 3D CAD and engineering drawings, using SolidWorks, Autodesk Fusion, Inventor or equivalent.
  • Good hands-on engineering aptitude and an interest in building, testing and troubleshooting prototypes.
  • Comfortable working in a laboratory environment and willing to learn PCR, digital PCR and basic molecular biology techniques.
  • Ability to analyse experimental or engineering data and document results clearly.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • Good organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through independently.
  • Comfortable communicating and coordinating with suppliers, customers and external engineering partners.
  • Willingness to take on a variety of technical and operational responsibilities in a small technology company.

Experience in medical devices, laboratory instruments, PCR/digital PCR, mechanical design, prototyping or laboratory automation would be advantageous but is not essential.

Fresh graduates with strong hands-on engineering skills are welcome to apply.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who is hands-on, adaptable and willing to learn. The position offers broad exposure to medical device development, digital PCR, laboratory automation and the commercialisation of new technologies.

The successful candidate will work closely with the company's technical leadership and external engineering specialists and will have the opportunity to take on increasing responsibility as our new products progress through development.

About JN Medsys

JN Medsys is a Singapore medtech company developing digital PCR instruments, consumables and molecular diagnostic technologies. Our current R&D activities include the development of a new generation of automated digital PCR systems integrating microfluidics, thermal cycling, optical detection and instrument automation.

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

As a Collections Representative, you will work with customers to resolve past-due consumer accounts and help them find appropriate ways to bring their accounts current. title: AR Admin Executive
description:
Role Mission：

This position is responsible for the day-to-day operations of the billing and inventory processes, ensuring that tasks are completed accurately and efficiently. This role involves working with a team to prepare invoices and delivery orders, maintain inventory, and ensure the timely recording of payments. This position will also be responsible for reviewing and verifying documents, performing general data entry, providing ad hoc support and backup to the team as required. This position requires strong inter-personal skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

Job Description：

1. Provide support to the team to ensure tasks are completed accurately and efficiently.

2. Tally and check documents to ensure consistency and accuracy before submission or filing.

3. Ensure payments are properly recorded in the system upon receipt and assist the team with "knocking off" payments in the system.

4. Maintain and monitor inventory levels, ensuring that stock is accurately recorded and managed in the system.

5. Perform general data entry duties as required, ensuring all information is accurately recorded and updated in the relevant systems.

6. Assist with ad hoc tasks and provide support to other departments as needed to ensure smooth operational flow.

7. Identify and implement improvements in billing, inventory, and payment processes to enhance efficiency and accuracy.

8. Generate reports related to invoices, payments, and inventory levels, providing regular updates to management.

Job requirements

  • Proven experience in a billing, inventory, or administrative role
  • Strong team work and inter-personal management skills.
  • Proficiency in data entry and familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or accounting software.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
  • Working knowledge of inventory management and accounting practices.
  • Excellent communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Ability to handle ad hoc tasks and prioritize responsibilities effectively.


Additional Information

  • 5.5 Day work week
  • Mon - Fri 8am to 5pm
  • Sat 8am to 12pm
